user_reviews.Name: Nicole Cruz
user_reviews.Description:
I don’t often take the time to leave reviews, but this shop truly deserves the recognition. I was on a field trip with 7th graders from Sacramento when I discovered a screw in my tire just after 5:00 p.m. — not exactly ideal timing! After calling two other tire shops, I was referred here because they stay open later, and I’m so grateful I was.
They told me to come right in, and from the moment we arrived, they were incredibly helpful and accommodating. I had my students with me, and within about 35 minutes we were safely back on the road and able to catch up with the rest of our group.
Their quick response and efficient service were an absolute lifesaver for those of us traveling from out of town. I truly appreciate the professionalism, kindness, and speedy turnaround — thank you for coming through when we needed it most!

user_reviews.Name: John Gonzales
user_reviews.Description:
My Tesla gave me an Alert yesterday (12/28/25) morning while driving indicating that my rear left tire was at just 30 psi. Pulled over, checked, and saw a piece of metal in the tread. Fortunately, it was a slow leak so I pumped it back to 42 psi with a portable and began a Tesla Mobile Service request. Tesla replied Tuesday AM. No thanks...

I saw Moe's Tires when I was cruisin' down Mission later in the day. I doubled back and crept seeing that they were open. Pulled up and was met with super-friendly service. Pricing was fair AND transparent. I was in and out in about an hour for a tire removal and inner patch - as a walk-in on a Sunday afternoon!

I hung around in their waiting area enjoying the Reggaeton blasting in the shop area while ALSO playing Midnight Club on Playstation 2 in "Joy Ride Mode"!! What a throwback 😅

This is a great shop. Employees were clearly happy and this is definitely a business I'd support wholeheartedly. My Rose is back and ready to troll the SF Bay Area! Thanks Moe's Tires - I'll be back for sure 🙂

user_reviews.Name: Jan M
user_reviews.Description:
**Avoid this shop.**

Year 1: We got a flat shortly after buying a new car and had it fixed here. A few more flats followed, and based on their recommendation we replaced all four tires with their "Premier snow and mud" tires.

Year 2: Three to four more slow leaking flats in a single year — each time we were told it was a "different tire." On the last visit I watched the technician and was told the flat was in the exact same spot as the previous repair. I saw that the spot had been patched multiple times over. So much for "different tires."

The owner then told me the hole was too big to fix and pushed me to buy a used tire from them and sign a waiver — despite the fact that they had sold us the full new set the year before. I declined and asked them to put the old patch back so I could drive to another shop. The technician said it was already patched but it wasn't holding.

I took the tire to a different shop. They inspected it and found no leak at all. The tire was fine.

So: repeat patches on the same spot while being told they were "different tires," a false claim that the tire was unfixable, a pitch to sell me a used tire, and likely an unnecessary new set the year before. I don't know how they have the ratings they do. Take your car somewhere else.

user_reviews.Name: V F
user_reviews.Description:
If you believe in karma and have ever been on the receiving end of an SFMTA ticket that was totally BS (so, basically every San Franciscan), think twice before giving this guy your business.

I’ve been a customer here twice. You’d think that would earn a little neighborly goodwill. Nope. The owner called SFMTA because my back bumper was barely in the red zone of a gated and locked driveway. Not blocking anything. Just… existing near his precious red paint. I parked overnight and was there in the morning to head out to work, but by 8:08 a.m., he had already gleefully called SFMTA. Ticket issued. Mission accomplished. $108 ticket issued.  I'm sure that made his day, like fresh puppy blood.

I’ve lived in this neighborhood for twenty years, and let me tell you — this guy treats calling SFMTA the way most people treat happy hour. He lives for it. If there’s a citation fairy, he’s her favorite pen pal.

So if you loathe SFMTA and their zero-tolerance tax on anyone who owns a car in SF — while the city seemingly enforces nothing on anyone else — DO NOT reward our neighborhood ogre someone who does this to former customers and neighbors. Get your tires at Costco or literally anywhere else.

user_reviews.Name: Saad Mirza
user_reviews.Description:
I called here today looking for some help with an O ring that got stuck in my tire valve stem. As a result, I couldn’t fill air.

The gentleman I spoke with indicated that it was impossible to remove. But in truth, it was easy to remove with a pick tool, or in my case, curved eyebrow scissors. After removing the tool, I filled my tires fine.

He also quoted $75 for a valve stem replacement, which is nearly the cost of a new tire from some suppliers. $30 is closer to market.
This shop is expensive!

user_reviews.Name: Praneeth W
user_reviews.Description: I came here wanting to like this shop, considering the high number of positive reviews.  I got bad news that all four of my tires were beyond repair (this is obviously not the shop's fault).  When I told the individual (I presume the owner) that my tires were recently replaced and should be under warranty, he kept telling me he couldn't give me a piece of paper saying the tires were looked at and they were beyond repair for "liability reasons."  I don't get it.  I understand the shop wants to sell tires and I was trying to make a warranty claim with tirerack, instead of buying immediately.  He also couldn't blow some air into my tire so I could drive away, for "liability reasons."  I've had better and friendlier service in numerous auto shops.  I did also think the $80 quote to do a flat repair (before we realized they were not repairable) was quite expensive compared to other shops in the city.

user_reviews.Name: Rhett Burden
user_reviews.Description: I visited Robert’s Tire and Wheels (986 Harrison Street) for the the first time today and it was a very pleasant experience. Upon arrival, I spoke to the owner of the business, Robert, who was very friendly and easy to work with. Robert has been in business in the Bay Area since 1979. In addition to the obvious, selling tires and wheels, Robert’s also offers several mechanical repairs ranging from belts and hoses to cooling system repairs. When I initially visited before the repairs took place, Robert asked, “what was I in need of and how could he help.” I’m not an auto technician so my ability to explain the situation is that of a layman. Robert came out to the vehicle, inspected all four (4) tires, taught me about the age of a tire by finding the date on it, and mentioned the importance of wear and tear. I purchased four (4) brand new tires and a wheel alignment. Luckily, Robert’s Tire and Wheels also offers coupons in their website. I was able to use a $60 off coupon. Robert‘a team changed my wheels and did the alignment in about 2 hours. Four new tires and a wheel alignment cost a little over $500 with the coupon which is fair. I’m pleased with the quality of the work, and would encourage anyone in need of tires, wheels, or service to check out this business!

user_reviews.Name: Eli McNees
user_reviews.Description: I start ratings with 5 stars. Toscalito lost 1 star for the 3 separate times I made appointments and showed up to be told they do not have my appointment on record. They lost another star when they made absolutely no effort to remedy that issue with the appointments. All I got was “sorry there is nothing we can do.” They lost another star when I finally was able to get in. They determined that my air filter needed to be replaced. Instead of calling to see if I wanted to get it done same day, they emailed me about it then called directly after saying my car was ready with no mention of the air filter. It seems Toscalito has no interest in providing any customer service as they know they’ll have plenty of other customers come through based on their location. Fine for them, but it leads to poor service on the actual vehicles when they have no price in actually ensuring that your vehicle is leaving there in the best shape it needs to be… as is proven by the air filter on my vehicle. It’s a minor detail but one that demonstrates the quality of care they take on your vehicle.

user_reviews.Name: Phil Conley
user_reviews.Description: Took my 2005 Honda Pilot in for oil change and inspection.  I knew there was a lot of deferred maintenance.  Received a detailed report within a few hours of the necessary work needed and then a call from Oscar with pricing and further explanation. Extremely thorough and detailed.  He explained what was critical in addition to things to keep an eye on.  Pricing was excellent and he found several coupon discounts to apply.  My car was done by the end of the day and they even stayed late to finish up a few last minute items that they had come across - including replacing a rear light at no charge.  They show you the work they actually did on the vehicle - not just tell you about it.  They seem to take a lot of pride in their work and even took me for a test drive when they completed the work!  I have had work done on my other two vehicles done there and always very great service and don't try to sell you maintenance/repairs you don't need.

user_reviews.Name: A G
user_reviews.Description:
Go anywhere else! In severe debt because of this place.

I let them know I wasn't working but needed a new tire. They talked me into buying new tires because my tires were old and supposedly balding but they weren't all that bad. They gave me an option to open a credit card with wheel works and lied and said it was 0% apr for the first year. I took advantage of the sweet deal (I thought), mind you I didn't have a job so I ended up using the card for food and gas and necessities and when I end up realizing they'd been charging me interest the whole time. When I tried to dispute this with the credit card company they were giving me the run around. They're all a bunch of scammers, they are trained to keep information from customers in order to charge us all sorts of bs fees. This is the most unethical company I have ever dealt with. Shame on wheel works for working with them and not being truthful with the customers. I won't ever recommend wheel works nor cfna to anyone. You're better off going to local tire shop or dealership.

user_reviews.Name: sabawoon alekozai
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
JUAREZ TIRES & BRAKES – Auto Service & Repairs

I purchased a full set of tires from Juarez Tires & Brakes and I couldn’t be happier with my experience. Their prices are very reasonable, and the service is truly outstanding. The team is professional, knowledgeable, and works on time.

What really impressed me was their honesty. I asked about getting a wheel alignment, and instead of doing it right away just to charge me, he told me, “First I’ll check if you actually need it, and then I’ll do it if necessary.” That says everything. Most other shops would have done it immediately without checking. This kind of honesty is rare these days, and I truly respect it.

I live in Bay Point, about 40 miles away, and I still choose to come to this shop because the quality, honesty, and customer service are absolutely worth the drive.

Highly recommended! I will definitely come back again and trust them with my car anytime. 🙌🚗

user_reviews.Name: Art Bodner
user_reviews.Description:
I have to admit I was a bit reluctant to take my car to Firestone for an oil change.  I have not had the best of luck with big chain stores, and generally find they do not have good customer service or competitive prices.  However, I was looking for a specific oil for my Honda Element and Firestone was only 1 of 2 place in the city that offered it.   I have to say I was very pleasantly surprised.  Great staff and hats off to their manager Milton, clearly he takes CUSTOMER SERVICE, with a capital C very seriously.  The price with discount at the time was very competitive.  When in the shop they found a problem with my sway bar connectors, which actually posed a safety risk.  They showed me what was going on and this was not some kind of up sale scam, and I could clearly see the mount was completely broken off.  It was suggested I change both, as age is often the contributing factor, and that made sense to me.

I have a regular mechanic, and get great prices with them, but since my car was already here and up on the rack, it seemed reasonable to see if they could accommodate my pricing expectations.  Could not have been nicer or more helpful.  So was able to get this done at a price that was as good or even better than if I took it to my regular mechanic.  The got the parts within just a few minutes and got right to it.  So was out the door with oil change and a repair that was needed for sure.

So happy to give them this positive review, and I will probably be back at the very least for my next oil change.

user_reviews.Name: Olivier Dubol
user_reviews.Description:
I recently picked up my rental car at the Avis San Francisco location, and I have to say the experience was outstanding — thanks entirely to one exceptional employee: Kien.

When we arrived, the car we were assigned didn't have a trunk cover to keep our luggage hidden, which was a must for us as we were embarking on a long road trip with a lot of gear. Without hesitation, Kien took the time to walk through the entire parking lot with us, exploring several alternatives and making multiple suggestions to find the right fit. Despite his best efforts, none of those vehicles had what we needed.

Just when we were starting to lose hope, we spotted another car that looked promising — and Kien immediately made it happen. No fuss, no reluctance, just a genuine willingness to make sure we left satisfied.

That level of dedication made a real difference. Our road trip through California, Utah, and Arizona went smoothly, and knowing our luggage was secure every time we stepped out of the car gave us real peace of mind throughout the entire journey.

Thank you so much, Kien — this is the kind of customer service that makes people come back. Highly recommend this location!

user_reviews.Name: Kayla O'Hara-Reyna
user_reviews.Description:
SCAM - BE AWARE. I've been through these reviews and there are consistent themes.

1.) Outrageous cleaning fees ($250-$450) for basic wear and tear like sand or dirt on floor matts. Not an excessive or damaging level "of dirty", essentially just in need of vacuuming.

2.) Cars consistently over or double booked. Not getting the same class as reserved months in advance, multiple trips to the agent desk upon realizing their car was already rented, waiting 2-8 hours for available inventory.

3.) Charges for damage or fuel that should've been documented at check-in. Cars sent out with tanks that aren't full or pre-existing damage, and the recipient being charged for those upon return with no channel for dispute ($550 - $650).

4.) Response to reviews - you may see lots of these reviews have a response from an agent with a case number. Those emails go nowhere, no one ever responds and they are purely for show to gain your trust. Don't believe it.

Clearly this location is rotten to the core because it's really an orchestrated scam for the entire customer experience from time of booking to the time of review. I highly recommend listening to others on here and saving yourself hundreds (if not thousands) of dollars.

user_reviews.Name: Daria Niescierowicz
user_reviews.Description:
Save yourself a headache and go to Budget / Avis near Embarcadero instead. You'll get a car fast and you won't feel like they're doing you a favor for the service you paid for.

In my 10+ years of renting cars, this was by far the worst experience I’ve ever had. I booked a car here for Sunday morning at 10:30am, arrived at 11am, only to be told I’d need to wait another 30 minutes. I didn’t actually receive my car until 12:30pm - wellllll past my reservation time, with zero apology.

I understand customer service can be exhausting, but that doesn’t excuse treating reservations like a suggestion instead of a commitment. Had I known a car wouldn’t be available for two full hours, I would have happily booked elsewhere. Sadly because of this delay, I missed my lunch reservation and had to completely change my road trip plans.

Then, on top of that I was pressured to purchase insurance, and interrogated when the car was inspected. Every interaction from start to finish felt predatory.

PLEASE: be transparent about availability. Apologize when you fail to deliver the service you promised. That’s the bare minimum.

user_reviews.Name: Brandon Tran
user_reviews.Description:
TL;DR: Consistent, friendly, and reliable service over many (10+) rentals. Location-specific tips at the end, but most importantly, sign up for Gold Plus Rewards (free) so you can skip the line! And Seema at the Gold desk is always the best!

Before moving, I rented from Hertz's Mason St. location ~biweekly and always enjoyed friendly and nearly no-wait service via the Gold Member counter on the Mezzanine floor. I never had an issue with them running out of vehicles and was often upgraded from Intermediate to Full Size, if not further, which more than makes up for the fact that as a non-airport location, they aren't able to offer Ultimate Choice for President's Circle / Five Star / etc. members.

After being away (and thus, not renting) for a while, I was soo surprised when the staff still recognized me, both at pickup and return. It was great catching up with them, and despite super busy Thanksgiving waits, I was able to secure a last-minute reservation and was in and out within 5 minutes—amazing compared to the 2-hour wait that Avis had that same day. A good review was long overdue for this location, but this latest experience truly blew me away.

Some tips I have from my many rentals here: (1) Definitely sign up for Gold Plus Rewards (it's free) so you can skip the line and head straight to Level M. Everything that follows assumes you're a Gold Rewards member. (2) As long as you make your reservation at least the night before, your vehicle will be assigned prior to your arrival (you can see it in the app), and the location sets your pickup time to 30 minutes after your initial start time (while still allowing you to pick up your car at the original time), allowing for a bit of extra flexibility in your pickup/return timing. (3) You may not get the multi-class upgrades you'd get through PC at airport locations, but the convenience and well-maintained fleet are a fair tradeoff.

user_reviews.Name: Viale M
user_reviews.Description:
We have rented vehicles from Sixt on four continents and have generally found their vehicles to be excellent. However, our recent experiences have been mixed, which made us approach this latest rental with some caution.

Lately, we've noticed a trend where the reserved car class is not always honored, sometimes resulting in a downgrade. Furthermore, the company has become surprisingly eager in identifying supposed, almost invisible defects upon return, demanding high payments of hundreds of dollars for minor scratches that were likely present before the car was picked up.

Indeed, our concerns seemed justified when, upon checking in this time, we realized the vehicle assigned to us was smaller than the one we had reserved. However, this is where the experience turned around completely. All credit goes to the local agent, Blake. He went above and beyond to make sure our needs were accommodated. Recognizing our predicament, he even gave us his personal mobile phone number to ensure we could reach him if we had any issues. Thankfully, we managed to fit our belongings and family members into the vehicle provided.

This rental was a perfect example of a situation where the corporation's system fell short, but an exceptional individual employee saved the day. Blake's outstanding service is the sole reason we remain satisfied Sixt customers and will consider renting from them in the foreseeable future.

As ordinary consumers, we are not paid or compensated in any way for this review. We believe in highlighting both systemic issues and outstanding individual performance.

user_reviews.Name: Aman Sharma
user_reviews.Description:
I don't know what will change your mind not to get a car for this company if this review doesn't.
I rented a car with this branch and had selected a luxury car Mercedez C300. When I reached the branch, the associate working had upgraded me to an Suv BMW X5 for a $100 charge. I got the car and the very next day, while I was traveling to a location in in California north of San Francisco with my family, the car suddenly had an engine failure. I couldn't even drive the car an inch after that. Upon contacting Sixt road side assistance,  they told me they could send a replacement car but I had to wait at the location of the breakdown until the replacement car shows up. They had promised me it would be there in 4 hours but I was left waiting for almost 7 hours. I tried explaining them that we are in a very unsafe place in the middle of nowhere and no gas stations  restaurants or hotels nearby and the closest town was several miles away but they told me if I left that place or arranged for a tow truck by myself then I would be liable to pay for it and I might be liable to pay for any damages on the car. So basically I was left with no choice but to wait for the replacement to show up. After all this, I sent them several emails to be compensated for this, all they did was deny any refunds without giving a reason. I was also charged the complete amount of $100 for the upgrade while I only got to keep the car for 1 day. EXTREMELY DISSAPOINTED with how this situation was handled and this shows the company doesn't care about their customers and gives them any car without proper checks. From what I know, cars, especially luxury brands do not have an engine breakdown all of a sudden, there's previous incidents or issues that weren't resolved that might have caused this to happen. I would never rent a car from this company again and warn anybody renting too.

user_reviews.Name: Dave Llewellyn Ng
user_reviews.Description:
I made an advanced rental booking for my National Parks trip (San Francisco - Yosemite - Death Valley - Grand / Antelope Canyon - Joshua Tree) in early September 2025 for my trip from 13 to 29 October 2025.

Given the proximity of this branch to BART 16th Street Mission, I made the booking under PFAR and received a BMW X1 as expected. This location is also conveniently beside a Chevron and a Gas & Shop Gasoline Station which makes refuelling and return a breeze. This was one of the best car rental experience that I have experienced.

Upon arrival for picking up, I was served by Andrew and his female manager and was taught how to use the free coffee and hot chocolate dispenser at their mini bar. After a quick and hassle-free run through of the condition of the BMW X1 assigned to me, I left after about an hour.

BEWARE!!! Update!!  SIXT continues to try to extort money out of me. Not paying your fraudulent charge there SIXT! I emailed them as they instructed. They sent me to Summit AR Collections. I'm so outraged. I have contacted my attorney.

Get all documentation, including the names of the representatives you are working with, for your own protection.

user_reviews.Name: Himanshu
user_reviews.Description:
We had a deeply disappointing experience with a dealer-arranged Hertz insurance replacement rental while our car was in for warranty work. We had to swap cars twice because the first had a cracked windshield, heavy smoke/coffee odors, scratches, and missing interior hardware, and the second car, also high‑mileage, arrived in similarly poor condition.

Local locations appeared short‑staffed, so coordinating pickup, three swaps total, and final return took over four hours of waiting across visits.

Near the end, the dealer failed to extend the rental, and Hertz staff told us near closing that they would only accept the car if we paid the unresolved balance or remove it from the lot and return Monday, potentially incurring extra days of charges while we sorted billing with dealer.

This was a direct dealer‑to‑Hertz B2B rental for an insurance/warranty repair, yet we were told to pay up or leave, instead of receiving help to reconcile the insurer vs. customer balance before close, which is unacceptable for an insurance replacement program.

We have receipts and were overcharged relative to the insurance portion, and we will be disputing the difference and asking for a refund of the excess charges

user_reviews.Name: Priscilla Thorner
user_reviews.Description:
I was a bit nervous after reading the negative reviews but (unless I get any additional billing later) my experience was quite smooth from start to finish. I was running late and called to let them know. They answered the phone promptly and assured me all was fine. When I got there, one couple in front of me, three folks manned the desk and my car was ready to go within a reasonable time. With Hertz Gold, your preferences are all applied in advance so that speeds up the process. Car was clean and comfortable.  Return was easy and got a physical and email receipt with the amount I was quoted.
The only 'glitch'  was that when I got an email reminding me to drop the car off, the return time was the time I had reserved the car, not the time I left the lot. This is nitpicky, for sure but, in my experience with other rental agencies, it is calculated 24 hours from the actual check out time.  Just one thing to consider if you think your travel plans might get you there late.  I expected to get there between noon and 1 so next time I will set the rental for 1! It is not an unfair policy but just a new policy to me.

user_reviews.Name: Ewa Jagla
user_reviews.Description:
We went to San Francisco for a 9 days trip. During that time we rented a car from the City Rent a Car on Mason Str.
We were told by the employee that if we won't fill in after the trip we will be charged for the difference .
Unfortunately during the conversation employee forgot  to articulate that if we return the car without full tank we will be charged $9.95 per gallon.
Because we don't know San Francisco we couldn't find the gas station . Cosequently we returned car with an empty tank.
The next day we sent email to the company informing them about issue but we got only short regretful message that we should read our contract.
Yes, that is true. We should read the contract but customer service representative should verbalize it in front of us as well!.
Also, ppl from different countries, who don't know S F. should be given information where the closest gas station is located.
Unpleasant experience.
Do not recommend

user_reviews.Name: Roman
user_reviews.Description:
I initially booked a mid-sized SUV with Budget for our trip to the US, but the car was much smaller than expected, and we couldn’t fit our luggage. With four people, that was my mistake for not double-checking the size. At first, one of the staff members wasn’t helpful, but then a Hungarian gentleman stepped in. He was incredibly kind and friendly, going above and beyond to upgrade us to a larger vehicle. Thanks to him, our trip, which we’d been planning for a year, was saved!

The upgraded car was great—no hidden costs, no limits, and the rental process was smooth with no long formalities. Dropping off the car at LAX was also a breeze. Budget's simple drop-off process was quick and efficient, with no wasted time. Plus, the shuttle bus service to the airport is excellent. If it's affordable, consider leaving a tip for the shuttle driver as a nice gesture. To the Hungarian staff member: you saved us, and I’m infinitely grateful! Thank you, Budget!

user_reviews.Name: Vasanti L
user_reviews.Description:
0 stars if I could. I am beside myself with anger as a result of my rental experience with Thrifty. We reserved a “Wild Card Compact or larger if available or similar” vehicle, a 5 PASSENGER VEHICLE, through Expedia. We arrived on time for our pickup. We were told no vehicles were available for at least two hours. I was offered the option to “upgrade” and pay extra for a vehicle immediately (which seemed contradictory to their statement that no vehicle was available – there were clearly vehicles available since I reserved a compact “or larger”). I said no, that I would wait two hours.

Then the agent calls his manager and says, actually, my vehicle is ready – it is a 12 passenger van. And that even if I wait, I will only be offered this vehicle. Again, I reserved a 5 PASSENGER VEHICLE. Offering a 12 passenger van is ABSURD and not in the spirit of what I reserved. I eventually agreed to pay USD$25 a day to rent a Nissan Rogue because I had no choice. My family needed a vehicle, and we were already out of pocket for our reservation.

Meanwhile, when we went into the garage to pick up our vehicle, we looked around and I expressed out loud to my husband “look at all the available cars!”. And a Thrifty employee walked by and said “I know, look at all the cars, AND I WORK HERE.” He knew the scam.

And that’s the key word. SCAM. This rental was a scam. We were scammed. The manager was completely unhelpful when I expressed how a 12 passenger vehicle (which in some instances actually requires a different class of license to operate) is a reasonable vehicle to make available to someone who reserved a 5 passenger vehicle.

I witnessed multiple other people subjected to this scam while I was in the office. Some of them hadn’t prepaid and were able to walk away. I was one of the unlucky ones.

And a note to the owner: I've already submitted my feedback on the Thrifty website - no response to date. Clearly people have been complaining for years, and you've done nothing to remedy the situation. You'll get yours.

user_reviews.Name: Matthew Estes
user_reviews.Description:
I should have read the reviews and went with a different rental company. We had a rental for 7 AM and they told us to sit down it would be about 10 minutes. After waiting a while I started reading reviews and found that this Thrifty is notorious for being late, overbooking and generally not being timely. Like most car rental places they try to upcharge you on everything. I would avoid renting from here unless you have time to sit and wait.

Also, the “managers special” was reportedly a Dodge Ram 1500. To get a smaller car it’s an up charge. I firmly believe that they do not have a Dodge Ram at this location. I did not see one in the parking garage on pick up or return. A customer came in after me with the managers special and was told that his would be a Dodge Ram 2500. I believe the big truck is a scare tactic as they anticipate you wanting to pay extra to avoid driving a big truck in the city.

Again, avoid this Thrifty/Hertz combo business at all costs.

I went into the garage, where I witnessed Hertz customers being given priority being assigned returning Thrifty cars (Hertz owns Thrifty & Dollar), even when Thrifty customers had been waiting longer. "Mid-Size SUV" was more like a small SUV, and smaller than the Jeep Compass or Nissan Rogue they advertise for that class. This flimsy Buick had a tiny cargo area with no cover, and didn't even have 4 stereo speakers.

All around terrible experience.

user_reviews.Name: Namheon Kim
user_reviews.Description:
First of all, this place assigns vehicles very quickly. I was satisfied with that part.
However, when it comes to the condition of the vehicle, even a score of zero feels too generous.
When I received the car, it had an overwhelmingly strong smell of marijuana.
My schedule was tight at the time, so I assumed the smell would go away soon and decided to go ahead. But that was my mistake.
The marijuana smell was deeply embedded in the car, and it gave me a headache the entire time I was driving. My children complained that they felt dizzy and were about to throw up.
The only thing I could do at the time was to drive with the windows fully rolled down in the freezing winter weather.
Once we arrived in another area, we had to urgently switch the vehicle, which forced us to cancel our planned travel itinerary.

It made me seriously question whether they even do basic cleaning before renting out their cars.
If you’re renting from this location and notice a strong smell, make sure to request a replacement vehicle.

user_reviews.Name: paul theobald
user_reviews.Description:
We booked a Mustang convertible for our dream holiday, my wife’s 50th, this was to drive down the California coastline from San Francisco to LA and then from LA to Vegas.
No mustang was available. No effort was made to source a mustang for us from another Hertz branch. We were given a jeep as an alternative, felt no option other than to take it as we were on a very tight schedule. The staff at Hertz branch Fishermans wharf San Francisco told me that they could not contact other branches for availability which is pretty shocking. They also told us that a mustang would not suit our needs as it would not fit all our luggage into, we later found out this was not the case. We were completely misled. On the rental agreement the car we booked was a Mustang convertible or similar. A jeep is not similar. The Jeep was uncomfortable for such a long journey, my wife has a back and knee issue and it was very hard for her to climb in and out of the jeep, it did not suit our needs at all and used an awful lot of fuel.  When we finally arrived in Las Vegas, we drove to Hertz returns at Harry Reid airport and finally got the car we asked for, our luggage fitted in the car just fine.  All of this was off our own backs with no help from Hertz or Virgin Atlantic, who we had booked it through.  We had the Mustang for four days and it was amazing and it really showed what we had missed out for the main part of our dream holiday. Very disappointed, ruined a substantial part of our road trip/holiday.

Take a look at the pictures.. hardly similar are they!!??

user_reviews.Name: Stephen Pike
user_reviews.Description:
Warning: Double check your return receipt at this location.

I rent vehicles frequently and hold both Avis Preferred and Budget Fastbreak memberships, so I am very familiar with how rentals normally work. In all my years renting cars, this is the first time I have ever felt like I was being scammed at an Avis/Budget branch.

Here is what happened.

I rented a vehicle for one day. I picked it up at 8:00 AM and returned it before 3:00 PM the same afternoon. The vehicle had three quarters of a tank of fuel when I picked it up, and I returned it at the exact same level.

When I returned the car, I handed the keys directly to the branch manager and assumed the vehicle would be checked in correctly.

That assumption was a mistake.

Two days later I received the emailed receipt and discovered that my total rental cost had nearly doubled.

The receipt showed the vehicle as being returned the next day, not the same afternoon. It also included a fuel charge for one gallon of gas, despite the car being returned at the same fuel level.

Those two adjustments were enough to almost double the cost of the rental.

I normally pay very close attention when renting cars in areas with heavy tourist traffic because billing issues and questionable add-ons tend to be more common in those environments. Unfortunately, I let my guard down this time and did not insist on seeing the car checked in before leaving.

Lesson learned.

If you rent from this location, do not leave until the vehicle has been checked in and you have a correct receipt in hand.

user_reviews.Description:
I had a very upsetting experience at the Avis Fisherman’s Wharf location.

I arrived with a valid reservation and asked a few simple, reasonable questions. However, the employee named Ali was extremely rude, dismissive, and arrogant. He refused to listen to me or answer my questions and repeatedly said “ok” in a mocking tone, which made me feel as though he was making fun of me.

When I tried to remain calm and end the conversation politely, his behavior continued. He then cancelled my reservation without my consent, stating, “I’m the boss.” As a customer—and especially as a woman—I felt very uncomfortable, disrespected, and humiliated by this interaction.

This level of customer service is completely unacceptable for a well-known company like Avis. I did nothing wrong, asked normal questions, and expected basic professionalism, but instead I was met with arrogance and disrespect.

I will not return to this location, and I sincerely hope Avis management takes this matter seriously so that other customers do not experience the same treatment.

user_reviews.Name: The HAT Project
user_reviews.Description:
The Sixt company is a bunch of crooks! They literally train their employees to pass on prior damage from past rentals to the next customer.

This happened to me twice! Once with my trip from SFO to LAX and again with my rental at their San Salvador location. Unfortunately, I booked both rentals in advance. I would’ve canceled my 2nd booking in El Salvador due to my experience with them in LA with them trying to charge me for damage I didn’t cause, which was curb rash to one of the rims, but I would’ve been charged a fee for that so I took my chances.
I didn’t believe they could possibly do the same thing in El Salvador, especially since the SUV I rented was brand new! Turns out there was curb rash just under the passenger side bumper, something you would never see unless you knew it was there. Luckily, I was ready and took a quality video this time of the entire car and was very lucky enough to capture the very minimal rash underneath the bumper.
I have no respect for a company like Sixt! Bunch of trained scammers!

Take very good pictures!
Also take a full video as well.
Videos and pictures capturing both upper and lower parts of the vehicle, including rims!

These crooks will try to ping a ding the size of a pebble on you!

The attached photos are of my two separate rentals.

SFO to LAX rental:
Are the rim pictures and curb rash they’re trying to blame me for.

Hyundai SUV pictures:
You can see the very faint rash underneath the bumper they tried pinning on me. You can see how minimal the “damage” could be and how these crooks will try their best to make an extra buck to spice up their profits.

user_reviews.Name: Nick Campbell
user_reviews.Description:
I have no idea where all these positive reviews are coming from.  One sentence summary of my experience, followed by a detailed log of the experience.

Don’t bother renting here, you’ll likely want to contact the better business bureau afterward.

Picked up car, it was a small basic sedan, not as described when I reserved it online.

Not 40 minutes later the sidewall of the tire blows out leaving me stranded on the side of the road.

I call SIXT for support, and instead of offering to help me, they suggested I change the tire myself to avoid having to pay for the tow truck out of my own pocket.

I put the donut spare on, and drive to the nearest SIXT location, an hour out of my way.

I explain the situation, and I’m told that the exchange would have to be done back at SFO where I picked up the car, but that he would check with his manager about making an exception.

I wait about 10 minutes and he says that they can indeed exchange the car.  But that I should make sure to put the 1/8 of a tank of gas back in the car to ensure I wouldn’t be charged for it.

I’m presented with the new car, also a Jetta, but an even more basic spec with no heated seats.

I take my video of the old car with the blown up tire and prepare to film the replacement to protect myself from charges of damage that I didn’t cause.  (Definitely do this if you dare to rent after reading this far).

Can’t film the new car because it’s blocked in to a parking space with 4 inches between it and a concrete wall, and the keys for the car that’s blocking are nowhere to be found.

The manager at this location is genuinely apologetic at this point and says she will look at my contract to see if she can provide some discount for the poor experience and delay.  Also said she would follow up with me via email that same day.  (Have yet to hear anything)

The rest of the experience is uneventful other than the return of the replacement car at SFO where they employ one of the AI car scanners to charge you for damage done to the car.  The other location didn’t have this and likely has only ever been inspected by humans, therefore I’m expecting a large bill for the AI tool being used on a damaged car for the first time.

Also, they don’t maintain the cars well.

Disappointing experience with Sixt at SFO. I rented a vehicle with numerous pre-existing scratches, signs of prior damage, and worn tires (selected photos attached below, and I also recorded a complete walkaround video documenting over 30 scratches and a large dent next to the right turning light). A Sixt representative inspected the car with me at drop-off, confirmed there was no new damage, and even thanked me for reporting the scratches in advance. However, days later, I received a damage claim for over $1,180 for two of the scratches identified, with no clear evidence that the alleged damage occurred during my rental period.

Despite providing video evidence from pickup, Sixt continued to pursue the claim. This feels like a predatory and unfair practice. Based on my experience and the many similar reports I’ve since discovered, I would not recommend this location. Renters beware document everything thoroughly.

user_reviews.Name: L H
user_reviews.Description:
We arrived early for our car pickup on December 7, but the experience was extremely disappointing. There were too many customers waiting, and the location clearly did not have enough staff or available vehicles. After standing in a long line, we were told there was no car ready for us, so we had to wait again.

When we finally received the first car, we noticed visible exterior damage. We requested a replacement, but the second car had a very strong cigarette smell inside. At that point, we had already spent almost three hours trying to get a car, so we were exhausted and did not ask to switch again.

Additionally, the weather conditions made it even harder to properly inspect the replacement car at pickup — it was cold, cloudy, and the entire vehicle was wet, so we could not clearly see the exterior or interior condition at that time.

After driving the car for a while, the smoke smell became overwhelming and started to make me feel sick. I honestly don’t know how I am supposed to deal with this for the entire upcoming week.

Later, once the car had dried and we had more time to look closely, we discovered several pre-existing issues with the vehicle:
1.	A very strong cigarette smoke smell inside the vehicle.
2.	Multiple scratches on the exterior.
3.	A noticeable dent/indent on the carpet area inside the car.

The front desk lady told us that she would document the smoke odor issue, but we are not sure whether this vehicle had any of these problems recorded previously.

The staff were friendly, but this location is clearly understaffed and unprepared for the number of customers. Overall, it was a very frustrating and stressful experience, and we really hope we won’t be charged for issues that were already there

user_reviews.Name: Juan Carlos Palacios
user_reviews.Description:
Terrible experience at Budget Rent a Car – Post Street, San Francisco.
I reserved an ICE (gas) vehicle online more than a week in advance and specifically paid extra for a non-electric car because I only needed it for one day and did not want the hassle of charging.
When I arrived, the first employee told me they had no ICE cars available and kept pushing me to take a cheaper electric vehicle. He even asked if a pickup truck would be okay and I said yes, that’s fine. Moments later, a supervisor named Norma came out, refused to make eye contact, spoke in a very rude and dismissive tone, and flatly told me I had to take an electric car — no discussion, no apology, no solution.
When I pointed out that I had a confirmed reservation and had already paid the premium for a gas vehicle, multiple employees shrugged and said “we don’t actually take reservations” and “reservations don’t guarantee a car.” That’s absurd — why let people book and pay extra then?
I travel frequently and have never been treated this rudely at any rental agency. Forcing a customer into an electric vehicle for a one-day rental is ridiculous when you know most people don’t want to waste 30–60 minutes (or more) hunting for a charger, or risk the massive penalty fees Budget charges if the EV isn’t returned at 80–100 %.
Completely unacceptable bait-and-switch, zero customer service, and openly admitting reservations mean nothing. Avoid this location (and maybe Budget and Avis altogether). I’ll be taking my business to Hertz, Enterprise, or literally anyone else from now on.

I would avoid at all costs. Enterprise at Fisherman's Wharf scammed my girlfriend and I. We booked online a car for one day the Sunday before Labor Day. When we arrived the person at the counter told us they'll be closed Labor Day and we won't be able to return it after 5PM, ie after hours return. Instead, the only thing we could do was pay for two days. We found this suspicious and he was nice enough to give us some money off and we went on our way seeing as how we already had plans. We later called Enterprise Corporate and found that this policy isn't real and we didn't need to rent the car an extra day.

In addition to this, I called the Fisherman's Wharf location regarding the MISINFORMATION they gave me about paying for the golden gate bridge toll and they never returned my call which is unfortunate because it was time sensitive. We'll be using another rental service in the future and I encourage you to do the same.

user_reviews.Name: A C
user_reviews.Description:
I've been renting from Enterprise Rent-A-Car for nearly 20 years, ever since my time as a management trainee on the East Coast. Knowing the company’s culture gives me confidence—if any issue arises and I'm within contract terms, they always make it right. On the rare occasion a branch manager falls short, corporate steps in quickly and effectively.

Enterprise consistently delivers top-tier customer service and doesn’t settle for less. Their pickup and drop-off service is a major convenience, and I especially appreciate the option to return a vehicle to a different location within San Francisco at no extra cost. Returning on a Sunday when few branches are open made this feature even more valuable.

I recently rented for a week-long road trip and had an excellent experience. Special thanks to Ethan, who picked me up and exemplified Enterprise’s values—courteous, professional, and helpful. He assisted with my upgraded vehicle and ensured my GPS unit was set up, which was essential for navigating remote areas in the Eastern Sierra. I don’t rely on phone GPS due to data concerns and reliability.

Overall, my experience was A+. I’ll definitely rent from this location again.

user_reviews.Name: Marla Blanchard
user_reviews.Description:
I was recently referred to O'Reilly's (more specifically I was told to ask for Sean).
I have weird water streaks on the inside of my drivers door and my passenger door. I thought it might have been a product I used on the doors to condition the interior.
Aaron from Stan Carlson Body shop tried 1 product from his shop and but it didn't work.
Aaron sent me to O'Reilly auto parts and told me to ask for Sean, who I believe to be the manager and said tell him "Aaron" sent me.
So off I go to O'Reilly's, I did meet w/Sean and BAMM, Sean new exactly what to do and even tried the product on my car doors. IT WORKED and I couldn't be happier.
Cruxt of this whole updated review is to give a shout out for the extraordinary Customer Service both businesses provided.
Something that is sorely lost these days ~ BUT, clearly it does exist and always needs to be recognized !
Tell Aaron I sent you, if you need great honest customer service for your vehicle.

user_reviews.Name: Miguel O
user_reviews.Description:
placed an online order to save time and get my order ready while i ran other errands. estimate is about an hour. about an hour later, i have no confirmation email yet  but im still in the neighborhood neighborhood running errands so i go kill more time so i don't have to come back to this side of town.

finally, after over 2 hours i really have to leave and still no confirmation email.... so i walk into the store. store is empty and not busy at all and the guys were just chillin and chatting at the counter and hadn't gotten started on my order yet until i showed up and asked about it. took them all of five minutes to get the stuff. annoying. if i knew the service would be unreliable i would've just gotten the stuff myself

if O'Reilly is gonna offer the online order service, corporate needs to figure out a better system for notifications so staff is aware orders are in and need to be fulfilled. either that and/or store staff needs to be more on top of it.

user_reviews.Name: Richard Springwater
user_reviews.Description: I removed the battery from my son’s car and brought it in to O’Reilly, after trying and failing to recharge it. I asked the clerk to check it but I assumed it was dead. The battery was at 8 volts and the clerk said he’d need to charge it in order to test it and I should come back in an hour. I returned later, sure that I would need to buy a new battery, and the clerk said the battery was fine and handed me the recharged battery.  I was staggered that they didn’t try to sell me a battery and I’ll be loyal to O’Reilly’s going forward.

user_reviews.Description: I tried to buy a serpentine belt here. My a/c compressor pulley broke, so I wanted to take it out of the loop. I measured the dimensions for the new pulley and called this O'Reilly's to see if they have the correct size. The guy I talked to didn't know how to search for a belt size and didn't seem to comprehend what I was talking about. He became upset due to his own incompetence. He transferred me to who I think was the manager, who also couldn't figure out how to search for a belt size. He told me, "That's the problem with modifying your vehicle." Not only were the employees at this store incompetent at their jobs, when asked to complete a simple task, they became upset. I understand that these chain stores are hiring random people these days, but to get upset at a potential customer for simply asking for a part is obviously a poor business model. I called NAPA later and had no trouble getting the right belt size.

user_reviews.Description:
I will never visit this store again. The Assistant Manager, Veronica, was completely dishonest and unprofessional. She assured me over the phone that the store would honor a price match, but once I arrived, the experience was entirely different.

She kept me waiting for an unreasonable amount of time and seemed to prioritize customers who spoke Spanish, which felt unfair and disrespectful. When she finally spoke with me, she repeatedly interrupted our conversation to talk to other people.

In the end, she refused to honor the promised price match, instead quoting a price that was about 40% higher than the verified price at Advance Auto Parts, even after reviewing it. This kind of misleading behavior and poor customer service is unacceptable.

user_reviews.Name: Alzila
user_reviews.Description: I was having breakfast in the area where I walked past here and noticed they had a O’Reilly Auto Parts location in the area. I was in need of a specific item for my brand new car and saw at first glance they had what I was looking for. The store is very organized and clean with items categorized by sections. Everything is mostly in stock and in display, you can ask the staffs directly to see if they have any inventory available if you do not see what you are looking for. The staffs here are very friendly, well trained, professional and understanding where my visit was a satisfying and issue free one. I highly recommend this place to all automobile enthusiasts, if you are in need of something for your vehicle just like me or if you just so happen to be in the area to check them out. I definitely will be back again to shop again!

user_reviews.Name: Lance Mellon
user_reviews.Description: I needed a battery because away from home I went to start my car and it barely started with a real slow battery and since I knew my battery was already 5 years old I knew I better get one. I went to O'Reilly's and got a quote of $219 or something like that for a battery for my little Honda fit. I knew that didn't sound right so I checked online and they were much cheaper but I needed one today. I called a couple more places and found there was a Napa Auto parts store about 2 miles away and I called and I got a quote over $100 cheaper than O'Reilly. I went there and I asked the guy if I could borrow a wrench and even though they had signs there that they would not lend tools he found me his socket wrench. I grabbed the battery put it in and about 5 or 10 minutes gave him his wrench back got my refund for the old battery and was on my way. What a fantastic experience. Otherwise I could have been out a ton of money. Car works great now by the way. Thanks Napa!

user_reviews.Name: Priscilla Tan
user_reviews.Description:
Mateo was my hero on a dark and stormy night. My windshield wipers got tangled on the freeway and stopped working, which was pretty terrifying. After several minutes of trying to wrestle them back on myself, I decided to go to O’Reilly’s to get a replacement set. Good thing cuz one was completely warped and required a screwdriver to pry off. This is the last time I’m using high school mobile detailers (who didn’t even clean between the seat and middle console!).

Anyway, Mateo was awesome, knowledgeable and even offered to help me swap the bum wipers out in the rain. He was friendly and honest, letting me know how I might be able to get a warranty in case there might be an issue with these new blades a year later (just need the invoice #). So grateful O’Reilly’s is even open late til 9pm! Great community resource!

I asked Steven if he could check other locations for me and there were two other locations have them but far from me. He kindly offered to order it for me and he said it would be in the store this morning when they open! It’s incredible that not only for a small piece Steven offered his kind service and also it arrives the very next early morning. On top of this morning I got a call from them saying the item has arrived!! What a pleasantly surprising experience and incredible sevice! I would definitely recommend this location and I would go to this location again and again if I need their assistance.

user_reviews.Description:
Hi family. Stopped by O’Reilly auto parts to replace the dome bulb in my car.

The employees were very helpful.

Also gave me tips on how to install it.

I was wondering if I would be able to install it as I was having challenges trying to get the cover off

If you are looking for a good deals on auto parts and great customer service stop by O’Reilly auto parts.

No, I know sometimes automobile places have a reputation of trying to take advantage of their customers, but O’Reilly auto parts was very helpful and guided me  through the process.

I wasn’t sure if I was getting the correct lightbulb.

The employee told me if it is not the correct lightbulb, bring it back and we will make sure you get the correct one.

Like I said, if you’re looking for good deals on auto parts and looking for good customer service then you might want to stop by O’Reilly auto parts.

Let them know Pastor Dre sent you.

user_reviews.Name: henok welday
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had a very frustrating experience at my local AutoZone that I feel compelled to share. I purchased a product that I ended up not needing, and when I went to return it (unused and in its original packaging with the receipt), the manager outright refused to accept it.

Despite the product being in perfect condition and well within the return policy guidelines, the manager was uncooperative and dismissive. HE WAS MORE FOCUSED ON CREATING A SCHEDULE WITH HIS EMPLOYEE FOR THE UPCOMING WEEK, COMPLETELY IGNORING MY CONCERNS. There was no valid reason given for the refusal, and the lack of customer service was shocking. As a loyal AutoZone customer, I expected better treatment, especially when the return policy clearly states that unused items can be returned.

This experience has left me feeling undervalued as a customer. The manager’s attitude was unprofessional, and it’s disappointing to see such poor handling of a simple return request. I hope AutoZone takes steps to train their staff better and ensure that customers are treated fairly and respectfully.

Until then, I’ll be reconsidering where I shop for my automotive needs.

user_reviews.Name: Mujiburrahman Afzali
user_reviews.Description:
I visited the AutoZone on C Chavez St in San Francisco on January 1st because I urgently needed help replacing my car battery. Unfortunately, the service I received was extremely disappointing and unprofessional.

When I asked the cashiers for help, they told me they don’t help with battery replacement. I then asked if I could borrow the tools so I could do it myself, and they said they don’t lend tools either. Since I was stuck, I asked them at least to tell me which tools I should buy to replace the battery. One young employee, who looked around 18 years old, said he didn’t know. He then asked another employee, who seemed annoyed and uninterested, and that person casually said, “Maybe 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, or 13 — one of them should work,” and walked away.

user_reviews.Description:
I had a really bad experience at this AutoZone location.

I purchased an alternator that turned out to be defective during the initial testing performed by my mechanic. The employee was informed that the part was failing and still instructed me to buy another alternator to continue the repair.

When I tried to exchange or return the defective alternator, the store refused, even though:
•	It was purchased the same day
•	I had the original receipt and box
•	The part failed during initial testing
•	The employee already knew it was defective

What made the experience even worse was the attitude of one employee, who repeatedly told me:
“I decide here.”
Even though he was just a regular employee, he spoke to me in an aggressive and very disrespectful manner, as if he had total authority over the situation.
Because of the poor management and lack of flexibility from the staff, I was put through hours of unnecessary stress and anxiety while already dealing with a car breakdown.
I want to highlight that the only kind, professional, and genuinely helpful person in this store was Dennys.
He was the only one who tried to find solutions instead of creating more problems. In my opinion, he should seriously be considered for a management position, as he was the only one who showed real customer service.

In the end, I did receive a refund, but the way I was treated was very bad and completely unnecessary.
I do not recommend this location.

user_reviews.Name: Christopher Lam
user_reviews.Description:
I have been going to Sam for all my automotive service needs for 8 years now (2007 to present day 2015).  The first time I stepped in his shop I told him I was fascinated with working on cars but had no idea where to start. He took a wrench and walked me through how to do an oil change, how to check all the fluids on my car, and what things to keep an eye out for that will wear-and-tear.

There have been times where I have called him where I was stuck at home with no idea how to fix the mess I created, and each time Sam has came through with a solution over the phone - I didn't even need to bring in the car.

I have had a Lexus (sold at 195k miles with no major issues), Mercedes (going strong with no major repairs @ 120k miles), and Acura (my precious baby currently @ 45k miles) - each of which have been taken care of by Sam

I know this is probably a perk for being a client of his for such a long time, but there have been plenty times where Sam has offered buying me lunch if I happen to come in during his lunch hour.

I have sent at least 8 friends to Sam for their automotive service needs (ranging from Mercedes, BMWs, Hondas, Lexus, Acuras, Toyotas) and each one have told me nothing but 5-star reviews - it feels great being able to give a good shop recommendation to friends so that dealerships aren't robbing them.

user_reviews.Name: mitch
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been going to The Garage for years and generally trusted their work, but my most recent experience left me disappointed.

I brought in my 2019 Acura TLX because two warning lights came on: “Emissions System Problem” and “Electric Parking Brake Problem.” They charged me over $230 for a diagnostic check, and I was surprised to learn that this fee isn’t applied toward the repair if you choose to move forward.

Their recommendation was to replace the part connecting the gas tank to the cap. The quoted price for the part alone was about $450, whereas I found the same part online for around $225 (plus labor). The overall estimate for repair was close to $1,000.

Before agreeing, I got a second opinion from another mechanic, who simply suggested resetting the warning lights first. That’s what I did, and it cost about $225 total. Two weeks later, I’m still driving with no issues and the lights never returned.

When I asked The Garage why both lights would appear at once, they said it’s common for multiple warnings to come on to prevent driving—but several mechanics I spoke with afterward told me they had never heard of that explanation.

It left me feeling like The Garage was recommending a costly repair without fully confirming the root cause. This is disappointing, especially since I’ve trusted them for years. I hope this was just an isolated experience, but it’s worth noting for anyone considering service here.

I’ve been a customer of this shop for 10 years+ , before it was “Stress Free” and never felt the need to leave a negative review until now. I was recently quoted $3,217 for a water pump and idler pulley on my Challenger Hellcat. Upon reviewing the estimate, $1,760 of that total was for the water pump alone. I had already purchased the same OEM pump for $750.

I understand and respect that shops have policies and may choose not to install customer-supplied parts (although this was my first time being denied this). The issue is a parts markup of over 150%, combined with already-in my opinion- above market rate labor rates. This feels inconsistent with the trust built over a decade of loyalty. While I get it’s a business, blatant excessive markups doesn’t reflect the neighborhood, customer-focused shop I once trusted.

user_reviews.Name: Mike Ng
user_reviews.Description:
Absolutely outstanding experience with Albert and his team.  Hayes Auto repair shop helped me fix up a broken front bumper and grill.  They helped take care of all the paperwork with the insurance company making the entire process far less stressful than I expected after getting in a weird accident where the person backed up into me while I was stopped.  Three major things to point out - 1) The quality of the workmanship was top notch.  Attention to detail was perfect - no panel gaps, paint matched, perfect replacement with materials 2) Albert was willing to go above and beyond - I had a specific bumper that was not quite OEM and Albert researched all the parts to replace it the exact way that I wanted even though it was more work.  He blew me away with his customer service  3) Appreciate being able to trust the team - I've heard all sorts of nightmare stories of auto body shops doing weird stuff to take advantage of situations, but Hayes Auto repair was incredibly fair, honest, and reasonable.  Their prices/value are excellent given the quality of their work and Albert checked in with me on each step of the way to make sure I was good with decisions he had to make.

Thank you so much Albert and Hayes Auto!  I hope I never need their services again, but I could not more adamantly recommend this company if you need auto body repairs!

user_reviews.Description:
I have been a loyal customer of Hayes Auto Body for several years now, and I can confidently say that they are the epitome of excellence in their craft. Whenever I've needed their services, whether it's minor repairs or major bodywork, they consistently deliver top-notch quality, ensuring that my vehicle looks as good as new.

What truly sets Hayes Auto Body apart is the person who runs the shop, Albert. His dedication to providing exceptional service is unparalleled. From the moment you step through the door, Albert goes above and beyond to ensure that your experience is nothing short of outstanding. His attention to detail and commitment to customer satisfaction are truly commendable.

Communication is key in any business, and Hayes Auto Body excels in this aspect. And regardless of the complexity of the job, Albert and his team treat every customer with the utmost respect and make them feel like a priority.

In addition to their exceptional craftsmanship and excellent customer service, Hayes Auto Body also offers fair and competitive pricing. They understand the importance of value for money, and I have always found their rates to be reasonable and transparent.

Overall, my experiences with Hayes Auto Body have consistently been positive, thanks in large part to the exceptional leadership of Albert. I cannot recommend them highly enough. If you're looking for a body shop that prioritizes quality, customer satisfaction, and integrity, look no further than Hayes Auto Body. Thank you, Albert, and the entire team, for your outstanding work!

user_reviews.Name: Stephan Kane
user_reviews.Description: If your car needs fixing, look no further. These guys get it done with ease, professionalism, and quality work. I shipped my 2002 Subaru Outback from Hawaii and it failed the CA smog test. The check engine light has been on for a couple of years and my trusty mechanic in Hawaii found that I needed to replace the breaks but said everything else was fine and offered to write a note to give to Matson shipping in order for them to let me ship the car with the check engine light on. After shipping it here there was also a shakiness when the car was in gear and also in neutral. I got in touch with another repair shop and they said I should see a Subaru specialist. So I called My Mechanic. Jhovanny (Joe) helped me through the whole process. They did a comprehensive inspection checking everything and found that I needed new tie rods because they were loose. If these break then you lose steering ability. The catalytic converter had to get replaced too. They found there was a faulty sensor which was causing the shakiness. All fixed and good to go. I would feel comfortable sending my grandmother to these guys to get her car worked on because I know they would be honest and do a good job. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Shawn C
user_reviews.Description:
I never thought I'd find a mechanic that would delight me enough to write a 5 star review, but this place is different than any other auto mechanic I've ever dealt with.

I came in for regular 30K service and spongy brakes, expecting a costly brake job, among other things. After dropping off the car, my phone rang a short while later. I answered, going into my typical defensive mode that I've grown accustomed to from past experience with auto mechanics, ready to question every single thing "wrong" with the car and the thousands of dollars about to be estimated to fix it.

"Your car's fine," said the voice on the other end. He explained that the brakes had plenty of life left and just needed to be bled. The only thing needed was an oil change and new air filter. The honest diagnosis was the most refreshing words I've ever heard coming through the phone from an auto mechanic.

I arrived later to pick up the car, prepared for the typical damage to the wallet. The bill was about 1/3 what I expected, and they did the brakes for free! These guys are awesome.

We've got a new mechanic for as long as these guys are around. Next time I come in, I know I can completely drop my guard and toss them the keys. They've earned my trust.

user_reviews.Name: James Deng
user_reviews.Description:
Decided to give it a shot on account of the reviews, generally reasonable experiences from people I've met and long lead times for Tesla Service but thus far my personal experience has been quite abject to say the least.

To start, brought a Model Y in for general maintenance on Tuesday morning for rountine maintenance and 4 specfic items listed in the service request submitted the friday prior. During drop off I was informed that a quote would be ready in about 2 hours, but did not hear back until over 6 hours later, 40 min before closing informing me that they were not able to finish a quote that day but next day would be possible. The following day, I was informed around noon that a  quote would not be ready until the day after, and upon requesting an estimate of when the repairs could be completed was not provided a reasonable estimate. This so far is not a great experience but for what occured next.

Upon not reciving a reasonabe estimate as to the timeline of repairs requested or a complete quote, I called in 1.5h ahead and requested my tires be rotated and to make sure there was no miscommunication, submitted the same via text which was confirmed recived when they called back 10 minutes subsequent.

Needless to say, the tires were not rotated.

user_reviews.Name: Richard Huskey
user_reviews.Description:
The folks at San Francisco Auto Works are absolutely INCREDIBLE. They are honest, transparent, and do high quality work. I’ve been taking my 2016 Subaru Impreza there for a variety of repairs over the years, and won’t go anywhere else.

Why am I so positive about these people? Let me give you one story as an example. A little while ago, nearly every warning light lit up on my dashboard (see photo). I took the car in and they diagnosed the issue: transmission valve body failure. They quoted me (a very fair) repair price. But before they ordered parts and scheduled the repair, they told me to call Subaru. Apparently this is a common problem on my car, and even though my car had 106k miles on it, I might qualify for an extended warranty program. Turns out, I did qualify for the warranty and Subaru did the repair for free. SF Auto Works helped me find a free repair; what an honest shop!

I’ll keep taking my car here. These folks are incredible, and I feel really lucky to know that they are around.

P.S. my dad was a professional mechanic and I grew up working on cars. This is a no-BS shop. Just good people doing great work.

user_reviews.Name: Minnie
user_reviews.Description: This place offers a relatively low diagnosis fee, but I'd be cautious about taking your car here for diagnoses (there's a reason why it's cheaper than other places). I had an intermittent no-start issue. Took my car here for a diagnosis, and they spent only a few minutes to run a battery test and came back telling me that it's a battery issue and it needs charging. I knew the battery is fine because I had it tested the day before. So I asked them to look further, and instead of doing a thorough diagnosis, Sam pressed the start button a few times and immediately made the conclusion that it's a starter issue and it needs to be replaced. I was surprised by how hasty he was so I asked how he knew, and he said that "well I'm a mechanic". Later he gave me an estimate of $1000 to replace the starter. Luckily I decided to take my car to the dealership instead, and turned out the issue was neither the battery nor the starter.

user_reviews.Name: Lord_Scoop
user_reviews.Description:
Steven deserves my first ever Google review.

Steven does a fantastic job. He’s super honest, knowledgeable, and has insanely good prices. First time I came to Steven several months ago for routine check up, all went well and Steven provided thorough notes about my car.

A few days ago i brought my car in (2013 Infiniti) with a broken exhaust system and he and his crew fixed the problem the same day. Steven was able to refer back to the notes he took on my car and he noted I had significant rust on the exhaust system. If I had brought my car to a dealer or probably anyone else, they would have recommended I get a new $3k exhaust system. Steven assessed the situation, and determined the rust could be cut away and replaced with fresh metal. He and his crew cut and welded the job. Everything turned out great, Steven even documented the process with video and provided updates.

Can’t recommend enough.

user_reviews.Name: Scott Pluder
user_reviews.Description:
If a job is worth doing it’s worth doing right…the dudes at k & c go above and beyond. Steven was busy at the front desk but chose to use text to communicate. I was able to send pictures and get diagnosed with an estimate. My serpentine belt was about to break and again in my opinion…. In a very professional, kind , and caring manner Steven made sure I was in the shop within a couple days. He even called me as soon as the part came in and offered to do it that day.

If bed side manner was a thing in mechanics it exists here.

Things have gone cold sometimes in the world and it’s hard to find a business that makes you feel appreciated as a customer. It’s a two way street… I’m very grateful for k&c and respect every bit of how they handled the business I brought to them.
Pleasant vibrations despite being in troubled times. Prices are fair honest and upfront.

Thank you so much k & c

If I need it
I know where to go

user_reviews.Name: Jeff Nebenzahl
user_reviews.Description:
Cars have changed a lot since I worked as an auto mechanic some 50 years ago. Without the tools and equipment needed for today's vehicles, I'm happy to bring our cars to a shop I can trust; and I've found that with International Sport Motors.

I'm probably not your average customer: I want to be involved in the diagnosis and repair planning every step of the way. Service manager Gelina was great to work with and gave me the space to do just that. When faced with a costly coolant line replacement, she found a smart way to get it done right while keeping the bill down. And when a fault code popped up that didn't quite make sense, she patiently heard out my theory and had her tech investigate. Turns out the fault was of my own making; easily resolved at no charge, with only my pride taking the hit.

After wiping the egg from my face, I'm more than happy to return to and recommend ISM in San Francisco.

user_reviews.Name: Joedei Siles
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough great things about Pearce Autotech. They specialize in Minis, and they have kept my 2012 Mini Cooper running smoothly and reliably. After another mechanic took me for a very expensive ride—and treated me like I didn’t know anything because I’m a woman—finding Pearce Autotech was such a relief. They’ve since saved me from unnecessary repairs and from work that had clearly been marked up simply because someone assumed I wouldn’t know better.

From day one, they have treated me with nothing but dignity and respect. They always take the time to clearly walk me through any repairs they’ve completed or recommend, explaining everything in a way that makes sense without ever being condescending. Their honesty and transparency are truly refreshing.

Everyone who works there is incredibly kind, professional, and welcoming. They’re also impressively timely with their repairs, which I really appreciate.

If you drive a Mini—or a BMW—this is absolutely the place to go. These guys are true Mini aficionados (most of them drive one too), and they are trustworthy, knowledgeable, and genuinely good people. I cannot recommend them enough.

I'm glad business is going well for you guys and I wish you the best. I found a mechanic closer to me who had no trouble finding the parts and helping me out with general maintenance (and they don't even claim to be European car specialist).

user_reviews.Description:
If I could rate this experience any less I would.  Step into Rex Auto Service being forewarned! Prepare for the worst. The most unprofessional shop I have ever encountered in my 50 years! Simply walk in and look at the disorganization and sad conditions of the place. I truly feel sorry for the sole overworked mechanic that works there (look at the low lighting conditions).

I visited Rex Auto Repair once again only to be told the EXACT same thing I was told 3 days prior. Evidently no work was done on it for the past 3 days with no reason and no apologies other than “we’ve been busy”. I decided to just give up on Rex Auto and would suggest anyone reading this would do themselves a favor by doing the same. There is no way they can stay in business like this for much longer. Good luck!!

user_reviews.Description:
I have been going to Enthusiast Auto Care for a little over a year for maintenance, installs, tuning, and all my questions I have on those.

He caught things I didn't notice and I appreciate the honesty as I like my car to be in good shape rather than a hidden surprise.

I have been tuned for a little over a year now and still enjoy driving my car with zero issues. I will continue to service my car here as I have nothing but good things to say about EAC and Eugene I know my money's well spent here with the customer service, quality and knowledge I receive here.
