user_reviews.Name: Rick Miron
user_reviews.Description:
It's official I have begun the tuning process for the Z and wanted to take a minute to leave an honest review of my experience thus far of what it's been like to work with Eugene Turkov.

I have been considering tuning my nismo Z34 for quite awhile now, what always put me off of it was the horror stories we have all heard at some point, and the fact that I was under the impression that I would lose the OEM tune incase I ever wanted to take the car back to basics for resale. I knew that If I was going to tune I wasn't going to go with just anyone.

I had heard of Eugene in various posts and through word of mouth over the years, and not once did I hear anything bad about him, everyone seemed to praise him as the VQ God and it took me all of maybe 30 mins of speaking to him to realize that what people were saying about this guy was no exaggeration.

The first thing I noticed about Eugene is the way he articulates himself, the way his mind works is very analytical and being in a mechanical trade myself I was instantly able to see that the way Eugene's brain works was not like your average gear head, every car enthusiast understands the basics of an engine but it became very clear from my first conversation with Eugene that he understood the VQ platform down to the most finite levels. He clearly articulated that not only does he understand the mechanical aspects of these cars but also understands the science behind them which is key to tuning any car for both peak performance and maximum longevity.

The way Eugene seemed to understand the VQ platform was unlike anything I have ever seen before, even in master mechanics who work on these cars day in and out, so I asked what he did for a living and was surprised to find out Eugene is an engineer for NASA. He will tell you that he doesn't want that to be the reason you choose to tune with him but I will tell you from personal experience that based on Eugene's education and experience in his professional life alone, there is no better tuner for the VQ platform on the planet, hands down.

Eugene's approach is simple, maximum performance, improved durability, improved longevity, improved efficiency. From the factory the OEM tunes leave a lot to be desired, Eugene quite simply has the knowledge, the experience and the skills to unlock the full potential of the VQ engine like no one else period.
The hardest part about the whole process was learning the
EcuTek Technologies Ltd program itself, but Eugene was there the entire way, walking me through it step by step. He is incredibly patient and honestly just an overall good dude.

Eugene is my tuner for as long as I own this car and I recommend anyone with a VQ to seriously consider working with him, my car feels night and day with just minimal performance mods, I can't even begin to imagine how much he can unlock with more performance modifications.

Tuning is a process, working with Eugene you will learn that process, he openly wants you to have the knowledge he has and is very open to teaching everyone he works with. There are other big name shops out there who in my opinion are overhyped for what they offer, you get a copy paste tune with the same maps as everyone else and that is where Eugene separates himself, his process is not a one and done, it is a constantly evolving procedure and he takes his time analyzing the finest details to ensure that his tunes are second to none.
If you are considering a tuner for your VQ Enthusiast auto care is the only option you should go with.

user_reviews.Name: Tom Nguyen
user_reviews.Description:
Eugene is the goat! I was not happy with my supercharger tune. Reaching out to him and in a matter of mins he reach back to me.

He won't just tune your car. He will go over the log and review it with you. Any questions or concerns he will address it.

For me I wanted reliability and safety for the motor. His tune has safety features built in the tune.

Why go with other tuners when all they do is tune it for power without fine tuning the small stuff. Fuel economy, better start up, better low end torque and reliability for the engine.

When we reviewed the tune, he found it was using much more fuel on startup, and the ignition time was way off when cruising.

If you want to be involved with how your tune gets done and how it starts and drive. Eugene is your guy, most tuner will just tune and get you a dyno number thats it. They really don't care. Your just another number.

There are communication delay with other tuners. You have a problem with the tune. Probably take 2-3 days to get a response from other tuners.

Tldr: go with Eugene if you want reliability, involvment and fast communication pipeline.

user_reviews.Name: Luis Armenta Gomez
user_reviews.Description:
Alright, so my Supercharged Z engine blew up. I contacted my tuner, let them know, then got ghosted. It makes you feel like you want to sell everything and never look back. This won’t be about that though.

This will be about going supercharged, except, doing it right this time. Through the spectacular service that Eugene Turkov and his shop Enthusiast Auto Care has to offer.

Communication

My experience with tuners is that you call them, leave a voicemail, and wait for a reply, if at all. However, Eugene is the only one that picks up immediately or replies within the hour. Multiple times, Eugene was able to guide me through crucial concerns over the phone: switching from 91 to E85, diagnosing a fuel / exhaust leak, and addressing a check engine light denoting lean conditions. Just recently, I was having issues with my car turning off while driving. I texted Eugene and he promptly gave me a call to troubleshoot it over the phone. That same day, he was able to take my car in and fix the issue.

Tuning Services

This supercharged Z is my daily driven vehicle, so I want to make sure that no issues occur during normal day-to-day driving. With Eugene’s road tune, we were able to address knocking issues that occurred during red lights, stop signs, and in traffic. I assume that this would have gone unnoticed with a dyno tune. He also programed a flex-fuel option so that I could drive my car anywhere, without worry of what type of gas I need to put.

The car is primarily on E85. It starts without any issues, cold or hot. Driving feels as if stock during lower RPMs. However, you can truly feel instant power once you push the pedal in. And it’s smooth. You can feel the boost rising as you go through higher RPMS. Considering the cars I raced, I should be in the high 400s to the low 500s, with the conservative tune.

I’m surprised people do not talk about his flames. I am throwing 1 to 3 foot long flames! When mentioning it, he said that he could stop them by adding code to the tune. Nah, I’m keeping them.

Mechanical Service

Eugene looked at every aspect of my car when I first brought it to his shop. He sent me pictures of slight precipitation in the supercharger fluid and oil, rodent damage, misplaced inner panels, repainted exterior and more. He also sent pictures to update me on the motor swap progress. It’s been 6 months and 5k miles since the motor swap, and still no issues. The oil looks almost new. He pulled apart the blown engine and found bent rods which most likely occurred by turning off knock sensors.

California Laws

Alright, we all know that going supercharged in Cali is becoming more and more difficult. I want to thank Eugene for helping me acquire the proper documents for the car; from smog to VIN verification and the CARB legal paperwork associated with the Stillen supercharger. If you want absolutely no issues with Cali laws, see Eugene or look into his CARB legal twin turbo kit.

You can daily a Supercharged Z. You just need to make sure you have the right tuner.

*Test pipe modifcation was for track use only along with any custom tunes or builds.

user_reviews.Name: Brian S
user_reviews.Description: Let me first start off by saying Eugene at Enthusiast Auto Care is a rare individual left in the car tuning community. I had the pleasure of working with him remotely this weekend in reprogramming and updating the software on my Infiniti. I was unable to get into my local dealership for several weeks and needed to re-flash and update my ECU as per cleaning the throttle bodies they didn't like the extreme air volume change. The car idle was erratic and made the car un-drivable. I searched around online for a solution and stumbled upon some references to this shop in California that can either mail out your ecu or have it remotely worked on. I was very hesitant as i really thought i was going to need something more serious done to get the car running right again. I emailed Eugene last weekend and explained what had happened, within no time he responded back with a simple yes he can fix it. I called him up and ordered a programmer from Enthusiast Auto Care. It showed up Saturday afternoon, Eugene texted me when i was good to go on getting things setup on my end. Fast forward to the following day Sunday evening Eugene called me up to get things wrapped up. Keep in mind he is in California and I am in Nebraska. I plugged my computer into the car via the programmer.  He logged into my laptop via some simple remote desktop software and proceeded to get the ECU first updated to proper firmware. That went without a hitch. Next he did the forced relearn of idle air volume which failed, I was worried things were worse than initially thought, but a few clicks and a reset later, he had the car idling back down to within stock parameters. In less than 30 mins he had my car running better and now the throttle response is so much more enjoyable as well! I would of been at least another week out before i would of even gotten into the dealership. I know i would of gotten the run around about needing new parts as this is the common symptom of the forums and this issue.  This is all it needed. He is a friendly, very knowledgeable automotive professional with a good reputation on the forums (which again is how I found out about this resolution!) and his precise expertise lives up to the hype in the real world. Thanks again Eugene!!

user_reviews.Name: Sherrie Syd Sotoodeh
user_reviews.Description: I'm so happy that I found an independent mechanic for my Fiat 500 Sport.   Nissi has given me great service and can usually fit me in within a day or two. They have worked with me on a repair plan for things that don't need immediate service and provided advice as I consider upgrading to a Fiat Abarth. I also really like being able to talk shop with a fellow gal, Ada, who loves cars like I do! I grew up in my dad's shop as he repaired classic European cars. Although I didn't learn enough to do the hardcore wrenching on my car (he should have at least taught me how to do an oil change, right? haha), I do understand why things happen and when something needs to be fixed right away. So it's great to be able to talk about my car's needs with someone who respects my opinion and questions and I know they do an honest job. I only wish they opened a little earlier or stayed open a little later because I usually have to take time off of work to drop off and pick up my car. It's still worth it to be able to avoid the dealership.

user_reviews.Description:
Kenny, Alvin, and the entire team at VAS Motor Works are phenomenal! Their professionalism, honesty, and deep knowledge of German cars truly set them apart. All of them drive German cars, have worked directly for the manufacturers or dealerships, and some have even visited automotive plants in Germany — so when you talk shop, you’re speaking with people who really know their craft.

They take the time to walk you through the problems, explain exactly what they’re going to do, and even show you the work once it’s done. Their transparency and communication give you total confidence in the service. The customer service is top-notch — friendly, thorough, and genuine.

I’ve been taking my 2010 VW Passat to the dealership since I bought it, but with rising labor rates across Bay Area dealers, finding VAS Motor Works has been a game changer. They’ve also helped me avoid unnecessary repairs that didn’t make sense for my car’s age.

This family-owned shop operates with integrity, passion, and care. If you drive a VW, Audi, BMW, Mini Cooper or Mercedes-Benz — or just appreciate German engineering — I can’t recommend them enough. I only wish I’d found them sooner!

user_reviews.Description:
Found my Audi mechanic (and dealer replacement).
Kenny and his team run a great and honest shop. If youve been looking for somewhere to take your Audi for routine maintenance or repair - especially if youve been going to the dealer - this is it.

Case in point: I  had a broken rear camera and in SF this is super useful. Dealer cost me $300 just to diagnose the problem (some broken wires) then wanted $3k to fix. Thats a lot for a 10 year old car (2015 A3).

I got referred to Kenny, and within a few hours of brining my car in, diagnosed the problem, explained the whole thing and why the dealer charges that (to replace the whole electronics harness which isnt needed in this case - and common issue - and higher hour cost) and fixed for  1/10th the cost.

I'll be bringing my car (and future cars) to Kenny and his team since I know nothing about cars and the value of a mechanic you can trust is essential.

user_reviews.Name: Ryan Guymer
user_reviews.Description:
Keyword: honesty.

Let's face it, mechanics have a bad rap due to their perceived level of honesty. It is for that reason I dreaded finding an auto shop. But I'll get to that in a minute.

I have an Audi A3 and was due for a 15k service. I've only ever had my vehicles serviced at the dealership, but this time the dealership quoted me $575 and couldn't get me in until July as they were booked up due to recalls. I had called a few mechanics in Santa Rosa (where I live) and was quoted anywhere between $190 and $425. Confused, I Googled the 15k service maintenance schedule and found Advanced Autowerks.

I tried calling them for a quote on a Monday and reached a third party answering service who forwarded along my message. I received a return call shortly after and was told the shop was closed on Monday, but they'd reach out to me by 9am Tuesday with a quote. Tuesday morning rolls around and I received a call as promised. I was quoted $250 with a 15% special and was informed of all the services that would be performed (which matched Audi's service schedule). I was able to book an appointment for the next day, unlike the two month waiting period through the dealership.

When I picked my car up, it was actually $100 less than the estimate I was quoted, as my brake fluid was fine and didn't need to be replaced (or flushed?). Knowing nothing about cars, they could have easily charged me the extra $100 and I would have never known the difference, but they didn't. Thus, I was happy I found an honest mechanic.
Overall, Advanced Autowerks saved me more than 68% off what the dealership would have cost and I am confident and happy in the work performed. From my first interaction - with someone calling me on their day off just to let me know they'd be in touch when the shop was opened the following day, to dropping off and picking up my car, I was thoroughly impressed with their friendliness and professionalism. They even left a Thank You note with a gift card to Philz Coffee - a nice surprise. The only surprise the dealership would have left would have been a ridiculously inflated final bill.

If you're hesitant about finding a trustworthy mechanic like I was, give Advanced Autowerks a shot - you won't be disappointed. I'll definitely be back.

user_reviews.Name: Logic and Reason
user_reviews.Description:
After seeing and driving a Lotus Evora 400 and finding the closest dealer couldn't get me exactly what I wanted, I went on a quest to find the color and option combination I wanted at the best possible price.  This is not always easy, especially when you're dealing with a manufacturer that brings in less than 50 cars nationwide each year.

I looked at available inventory online in just about every sales channel, and worked on pricing with three dealers across the country that had the general configuration I wanted.

Except one really stood out, they had the right exterior color and option list, but not interior and were really communicative.  When I made my desired interior color known, Mike West at Cars Dawydiak offered to swap in what I was looking for to make a deal happen, and guaranty no issues.  That's where I made the decision to purchase from Mike immediately.  Simply put, he is the most engaged relationship oriented car sales guy I've ever worked with.

The purchase process was reasonably simple, no "dealer fees" were added to a reasonable negotiated price--which, had I been local, would have been one of the best deals in the country.

All paperwork was exchanged by Federal Express, including ownership documentation which was instantly accepted for registration in my state-not always the case on out of state transactions.

During the entire process, Mike kept me up to date on everything, literally everything - even the interior change over was photo'd and sent along real time, and warehousing of the car covered up while it awaited shipper pickup too.

When the car was ready to go, he sent me photos and video of the car loading on the carriers truck.  During transit he checked in to see if it was in yet.

Really, I'm not sure there is a better relationship focused manager in the industry than Mike West-he's certainly the best in the hundred cars or so I've purchased over the years.  He is definitely the best I've worked with for inter-state sight unseen deals on specialty stuff.

I never would have thought my Lotus purchase would originate in San Francisco, considering I'm way over in North Carolina, but Mike made the deal easy, added value that no one else would, and provided service that is simply over the top.

Very impressed.  Thanks Mike.

user_reviews.Name: Ben Hall Drake
user_reviews.Description:
I have had two separate services done at this shop, both were great quality, done on time, and were extremely well priced.

First job was for an aftermarket radio, where I actually first went in to undo damage as I failed to wire it myself late on a Friday. Owner diagnosed the problem as just a popped fuse (fixed for free), and offered to test the radio to see if it worked. After doing half the wiring it was discovered that the radio did fail, and we scheduled a follow-up appointment after I got a new radio (note, the work was done into after hours for the business, super generous of them). Despite 2 appointments, the owner only charged me for 1 appointment as it was 1 job, despite it being my mistake. Radio works great several months after the job, despite it being plugged into a very old wiring harness on the car-side.

Second job was installing a bolt-on aftermarket exhaust. I initially called the owner to inquire about pricing for a custom exhaust, and he recommended that a full-custom exhaust would likely not fit my needs and be quite expensive as I was looking for a cat-back system, and a bolt-on would likely be better for my car and he could make any adjustments to it as I see fit. Had the shop install it, charged only 1 hour of labor which is $150 (excellent prices for the bay area). Sounds great, very happy with it and the price to labor ratio is just too good to be beaten. For context, dealership prices for my make (Volvo) are $300 in the city, and the best independent shop I found that focuses on Volvo's are at $180 an hour currently.

Great business owner and very knowledgeable. Best part of his business is that he does not oversell or rack up hours of labor. Super kind guy as well!

Only negative is that it is a small business and so sometimes appointments can fall through the cracks or they may be understaffed sometimes, and so flexibility is required when working with them. However, I think this is due to them having quite a lot of business, as when I went there were many cars in the bays being worked on.

If you want great service at extremely great prices and tons of knowledge, come here! They are great value for any custom work, large or small.  I will continue to come to Auto Sound Performance for advanced services, with my current vehicle and the next, and if anything wrong happens I am confident they will make it right.

user_reviews.Name: Brendan B
user_reviews.Description:
I am extremely happy with Auto Sound Performance, so much so that I am now a repeat customer. When the on-off switch on my Fiesta's factory head unit began malfunctioning, I determined the only fix was to replace the head unit.

This would have cost a fortune at my local Ford dealership, but a guy in the parts department told me I could trust Auto Sound Performance to do an aftermarket install, and he was correct!

A 2011 Fiesta is a somewhat tricky thing, because the factory head unit lives inside a really weird, proprietary dash board housing. But service writer Axel and owner Andrew knew just what to do, in terms of sourcing an adapter that allowed them to install a "floating" touch screen in my car.

Axel and Andrew were very sensitive to my comfort level regarding the cost of this job, and this is important to note: I'm sure most people who come to an aftermarket stereo and electronics shop are looking to drop big money on a "system" that can make the pavement ripple, but all I needed was a mild upgrade that would fit within a specific budget. And Auto Sound Performance delivered!

My original goal had just been to replace my malfunctioning factory head unit so it would stop turning itself on and draining the  battery while the car was parked. What I got was a fully modern touch screen stereo with new speakers and a back-up camera, for a very reasonable price.

And the sound quality in my car is now off the charts! Suddenly I can hear nuance and beauty in every piece of music I listen to, and, at long last, when I play an audiobook, I can actually hear it without having to crank the volume all the way up.

Furthermore, when it came to any little doubts or concerns I had about any aspect of my install, or how it was configured, Axel and Andrew were always eager to have me come back in and have whatever I wanted tweaked or adjusted so I'd be completely satisfied. These guys are not looking to sell you a system and have you never bother them again; they are building relationships with their customers, and that is why I more recently brought them my friend's van so they could similarly work their magic on that vehicle.

If you need a stereo, subwoofer, amp, dash cam, or anything else installed on or in your car, Auto Sound Performance should be the first shop you talk to!

user_reviews.Name: David Rouda
user_reviews.Description:
The technicians are good. The older gentleman who worked on my Mercedes really knows his stuff so that's a major benefit . The shop is clean .

The manager Greg is a sometimes nice guy that seems to be moody at times and he can come across almost rude. In fact he's rude so often that I started laughing to myself recently at how tone deaf he seems.  I called him the morning after the evening he sent me notice that my car was done.  He gruffly said that I had had my car there too long. It was less than 12 hours after his evening notice of completion!

I told him I would come in on Monday (the next business day) to pick it up then texted Monday saying I had a medical issue and needed to come in the next day. When I picked up the car as stated, he said gruffly he was going to start charging me storage cost and everything about him seemed annoyed by my presence and that I was his customer. I have been nothing but nice to this guy and spent over 12k on some fairly basic stuff for this classic car.  He said he didn't get my text but that's on him. When I told him that he is sounding rude when I am a paying customer that is spending good money on his services he said we can end our relationship. I didn't know that we had a "relationship"!  Lol!  He softened up after that cuz I think he felt bad but again it's all kind of laughable, his moodiness.

He is personally knowledgeable about these classic cars as he seems to have owned quite a few of them himself. He also seems to rely on AI a lot for his information about cars and it's not always correct so look it up yourself. For example, I wanted to remove the heater covers to get them re-chromed and he said they'll break because they're "pot metal". AI does say that but *not for this car* and if you delve further they are nice forged brass on a 190 SL. They also charged me for removing the chrome parts but they didn't remove the chrome parts entirely that I asked them to despite specific instructions. Also the car was filthy dirty when I came to pick it up, and the rear view mirror was all twisted the wrong Direction and coming out of its seating.  Online it's touted that they wash your vehicle.

Anyway Gregs run a pretty tight ship but I think Greg could learn the old business adage a little better: "the customer is always right."

Especially given the premium prices they charge their customers! (granted they have a premium location in the heart of Russian Hill Polk Street area)

There are alternatives in the City with nicer attitudes and not as expensive.  I may go back to Pete's when needed but I may try some other spots like Sal's in SF.

user_reviews.Description:

user_reviews.Name: Adele
user_reviews.Description:
What a dream team that provides high quality bumper repair work with exceptional customer service and very competitive prices.

Back in March 2024, I reversed into a tree (lulz) and damaged the rear bumper of my friend’s convertible, creating a big ol’ dent and two holes. Over the course of a month, I shopped around for quotes and got estimates from 5 SF auto body repair shops.

Selecta stood out for a variety of reasons:
1. Their estimate was the best priced. Their hourly labor rate is a bit cheaper, and it makes a difference.
2. They were the only ones who evaluated whether a repair would be possible. They were confident they could do a full repair, which helped bring the cost down by $400. All the other shops said that I needed a bumper replacement, and that BMW bumper part is not cheap. Even Selecta’s replacement quote beat out other shops by $200-300.
3. Their customer service is top notch. Their office manager Jackie picks up the phone in 2 seconds. And estimator Gene is the sweetest soul. You can tell he cares deeply about the work and the customer.
4. Last but not least, their quality is sensational. They fixed up some of the other scratches, and the bumper looks brand spanking new. They offer a lifetime warranty on their work to boot!

Keep in mind that you need to book an estimate appointment since they make sure they have space for you to pull up in front of their shop. I also had to wait two weeks for them to have availability to work on the car. They quoted 2-3 business days in the shop—it would have taken them 2 days had the dealership shipped the correct part. The car came home 4.5 days later looking like a beaut!

While I hope to not need future auto body work, you can best believe that I am bringing all my future needs to Selecta (and actively recommending them to friends and family too)!

user_reviews.Name: Gahl Yogu
user_reviews.Description:
I'm all for giving good reviews but my experience must be heard, because it's insane what they did...

Conclusion:
Sorry but I would NOT RECOMMEND going here. The work quality was a complete failure. Too many MAJOR flags.

I'm not trying to give an irrational irate review..yes I'm pissed but I'm listing obvious reasons why you should not go here. I'm calling out BASIC WORK that any respectable body shop would do and laying the facts with pictures.

Backstory:
- My car is a black 2019 mustang, is expensive and valuable. I've modified the car so it has some sentimental value as well.

- Took my car in for a quarter panel repair.

- Spoke to Bing directly. He was very friendly and assured me he had years of experience.

- I didn't have insurance so I had to pay out of pocket. Thousands of dollars for this work. He seemed sympathetic and willing to help me out.

Experience:
- They did not finish sanding the bondo and left cross sand marks in the bondo which they PAINTED OVER

- Had to repaint my car twice (had to bring the car back twice) because of mistakes.

- My car still has left over unfixed "work" (major mistakes) till this day (see screenshots)

- Poor bondo work (the putty they use to shape cars) on the quarter panel wheel weld arch, WASNT EVEN ROUND! MAJOR concern (please read below why). Additionally the quarter panel is not even shaped to original.

- Did all the sanding and prep work with the car windows down. I had to clean the car of metal flakes and paint dust after it was returned (i have pictures)

- Received car with oily polish swirl marks + dry polish on the car (have pictures of that) had to polish the car myself with a machine polisher. I doubt the average customer can do that or should need to do that

Justifying this list so I don't sound like I'm irrationally ranting..

1. Sanded and did all the prep work with the car windows rolled down. I had metal flakes and dust to clean up once i got the car back. Clearly quality isn't a concern since one of the owners himself sent me a picture of the car in progress and you can see the dust. This is paint and metal particles not just plain dust.

2. They returned the car with hardened bondo drippings on the quarter panel arch. Literally looked like an arch with icicles hanging from it. The arch wasn't even round! The reason is they didnt sand it during prep (BASIC STEP)... and the fact they painted over it is a major red flag to begin with. Very low quality work for a body shop ASK any body respectable who works at a body shop.

3. Brought my car back since they agreed to fix it and took responsibility for the bad quality prep work. So they fix the wheel arch and then repaint the car. Had to wait another week or two again for that.

4. Get my car back the second time with oil polish and swirl marks all over it.There was dry polish or maybe primer overspray on the door jambs, the wheels, the window and quarter panel. If you dont know about this , this stuff DOES NOT come off with soap and water.  The guy was watering it down when I picked it up so I couldn't even seen these till i got home.

5. I had to re polish the car with a machine polisher after I got it back (average person cant do this, but why should they) Texted him about that to see if he would do it and he chose to stop responding so I had to re polish the car myself.

6. THE WORST ..  I finally noticed they DID NOT finish sanding the car!! They left cross hatch sanding marks in the bondo along the WHOLE car (fender, door + quarter panel) These are little cross hatches done during prep work which need to be sanded flat BEFORE painting. This is just BASIC prep work that any respectable autobody shop would do. Please ask any one.

8. Another MAJOR REASON the quarter panel is not even sanded to shape the original body. You can see the bondo buldging out. To fix this the work would need to be redone.

7. These cross hatch sanding marks are in the bondo so the car will need to be stripped and sanded again then repainted to fix it. At this points its a year later. I'll have to take it somewhere else.

user_reviews.Name: Maddie Lew
user_reviews.Description:
This past month was a rough one. I got my roof racks pried off and then a week later, I was sideswiped. I was left with 3 sizable dents on the driver’s side and feeling really down about the way my car looked. I called a bunch of auto body shops around the Richmond area and Will’s shop happened to be the first. Romeo quoted my car quickly and thoroughly, emphasizing on what was necessary. He was kind, personable, and walked me through the process. After getting multiple quotes and taking the time to mull it all over, I decided to go forward with Will’s due to a great first impression and reasonable price point. All I can say is: I’m so glad I did!

I took my car in yesterday morning around 10AM and was greeted by more welcoming faces—Romeo and Martin, ya’ll are the absolute best. I’ve never felt so at home at an auto body shop, especially considering how misogynistic other places can be. Less than 24 hours my car is looking brand new!!

Thank you so much Romeo, Martin, and all of the other hardworking people that helped make my car something to be proud of again. I appreciate you all!

user_reviews.Name: zevilevi
user_reviews.Description:
Will's Auto Body Shop is the best auto shop I have ever been to.

As an owner of a handful of cars over the past 30 years, I have had many experiences at auto body shops. Will's Auto Body Shop does the BEST WORK, for the BEST PRICE, and they are SUPER FRIENDLY and HONEST.

Most recently, I worked with Romeo, who is very easy going, super knowledgeable, and ethical! Finding ethical folks can be hard, but not at Will's!

Today, I just picked up my Mercedes-Benz after I was rear-ended on 101 and needed my bumper repaired. They did an impeccable job repairing NOT JUST the damage they charged me for, but they went ABOVE AND BEYOND, fixing up a few other dings and scratches that they found while they had the car. They matched paint precisely, fixed the damage, and made the car look brand new.

Furthermore, the job was more complicated than they initially thought it would be, but guess what? They didn't call me to gouge me for more money; instead, they just fixed it and were super chill about it.

All this to say, I am a customer here FOR LIFE. And if you need auto body work, YOU SHOULD BE TOO!

I am just absolutely thrilled with the quality and care shown by this business and EVERY employee there.

user_reviews.Name: charles schober
user_reviews.Description: First I want to say I choose this shop for a paint repair because of all the positive reviews and I want to say they did not disappoint me. They lived up to all the great reviews and then some. I use to live in SF and now live near San Leandro and was glad I drove the 20 mi. to get the work done there. Not only is their work impeccable, but Bobby and Romeo were some of the most friendly, professional staff I had come across in a long time. They understood when I had to reschedule due to an unprecedented heatwave but they even worked with me for an initial approximate estimate saving me a trip just for viewing by submitting photos. Romeo even repaired a few dings that was not included in the estimate to make the job look perfect. Even as busy as they are Romeo took the time necessary on the phone to discuss my repair and all the confusion I was having with my insurance company. In this day and age I don’t find many places that I really feel go out of their way to make sure the job and complete experience is a positive one like they did. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS SHOP FOR ANY BODY WORK YOU NEED.

user_reviews.Name: Kabir Gill
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been to Bryant Bay Area Auto Body twice now for two separate incidents (ah, SF living): once when my car was rear-ended and vandalized, and another time when it was hit while parked. Both times, they went above and beyond in every possible way.

Ian, who runs the shop, is absolutely fantastic. He works directly with the insurance companies to make sure you get OEM parts, even when it’s not the easiest route. I drive a 2002 BMW E46 M3—not the easiest car to source or repair—and Ian made sure every part was correct, every detail matched, and the result was flawless.

What really sets this shop apart is how much care they put into their work. Ian not only fixed the reported damage, but also took it upon himself to repair scratches and imperfections I hadn’t even noticed—just because he’s a genuinely good guy who takes pride in his work. The service is top-tier: frequent photo updates, great communication, and absolutely unmatched quality.

Luis, who works at the shop, is also incredibly kind and helpful. When I picked up the car, it had been polished and deep cleaned inside and out—truly looked better than ever. This kind of attention to detail is rare and deserves recognition.

If you need any kind of bodywork done, I can’t recommend this place enough. These guys are the real deal.

user_reviews.Name: Bryant Lee
user_reviews.Description:
Simon was able to take me in immediately that one incredibly stressful morning when I woke up to my Tesla Y completely wrecked after a hit and run while it was parked overnight in my neighborhood. No note. Sentry mode didn’t capture anything. The driver side rear panel, taillight, and charging port were completely damaged. It was such a sad day and my heart sank after discovering, but Simon reassured that he’ll take care of me. And that he did.

In 3 week’s time, he texted and said the car was ready. Before even starting work on my car, he clearly told me he’s not going to rush anything and wants the best quality job done so it’ll look like new. I was in complete agreement and told him to take his time. Throughout the waiting period, Simon constantly messaged me photos of the progress and communicated with my insurance. Payment was smooth and stress free. On pickup day, I couldn’t believe how clean my baby looked! Like from out of the dealer lot. Everything looked new and functioned the way it should.

Living in the city will have its ups and downs, and this was definitely one of those really frustrating and disappointing moments in my life. But when you have dependable, trust-worthy folks like Simon and his team at Auto Body Garage, you can move forward and not lament over things that you may not have control over. I’d recommend anyone to this establishment for your auto body needs.

user_reviews.Name: Roseann
user_reviews.Description:
I've had two outstanding experiences with Simon & Auto Body Garage.

1. Integrity: Over a decade ago I had my, then, new car's windows tinted at the company that is now Auto Body Garage. They had warrantied their work for a lifetime. When that tinting started to fail, I called to see if they would honor this for a replacement. I learned that Simon had acquired the business and no longer focuses on window tinting, but would still honor the warranty. He came through and paid for my new window tinting with a different company. Wowzers!

2. Competence & Quality: Per my first experience with Simon, I decided to reach out to him for an estimate on some cosmetic repairs for my aging car - a little nip/ tuck. Literally, the day after I met with Simon for this estimate, I was hit by woman who had lost control of her car (confusing the accelerator for the brake). No kidding - I can't make that up! user_reviews.Name: R M
user_reviews.Description: Too Good Auto Body Repair has been my go-to car repair shop for almost 20 years. I have had some old cars and they take the time to make the needed repairs at a reasonable cost. Recently, my 2003 Toyota 4Runner (over 220K miles) was making unusual sounds and could not be driven safely. Although there were many shops in the South Bay available for repairs, I used my Premium AAA tow benefits to have it towed 40 miles to Too Good Auto Body Repair, where I can trust the workmanship and cost of the work by Steven Chin and his brother Tony Chin. Steven test drove the car and found upon inspection that the brake master cylinder had to overhauled and the front wheel hub coil springs and brake pads had to be replace. They promptly found the parts and made the necessary repairs at a reasonable cost. They thoroughly checked the car for any other potentially urgently needed repairs and even replaced three light bulbs and buff the headlights that I have been been meaning to do for months. Thanks so much to Steven and Tony Chin for their exceptionally professional handling of the needed car repairs and dealing honestly with seniors citizens/women.

user_reviews.Name: Persephone Chen
user_reviews.Description:
My car got broken into on 8/2. I was out of town so my mom helped to arranged for it to be towed to the shop. She already paid for the towing service which was $217, and Steven claimed $497 and got the check from my insurance.

There was no other damages besides the broken windows. Weeks later, Steven told me that there are some scratches (which were not there when I dropped off the car key). I think these were caused by someone pressing the broken glass to smear them on the car body. He filed for a total $6k+ claim including products and services he quietly added to the estimation for repairing/replacing the body and parts that he vandalized.

I’ve reported this to the national and state bureaus for insurance fraud, and the CA bureau of auto repair along with my insurance’s SIU.

I hope he’s not going to secretly damage my car further because I will have to take legal actions before any bureaus did.

user_reviews.Name: Vince
user_reviews.Description:
This is the second or third time I’ve taken my Tesla here after getting hit by other drivers, and they’ve handled everything perfectly each time.
They’re a Tesla certified collision shop that does a better job than Tesla’s own auto body shop (I’ve heard bad things.) I like this shop so much I would bring my car here over Tesla’s own body shop. These guys seem to know Teslas way better—inside and out. They catch hidden damage that the insurance adjuster completely missed and they’re also experts at dealing with the at fault party’s insurance.

On top of that, they’re trusted enough to have a contract fixing up new VinFast cars that got damaged in transport—bringing them back to brand-new condition (before cars are sold.)

If you have a Tesla (or even if you don’t), this is the place I’d go to every time. I’ll definitely keep coming back. This shop knows cars and are honest to work with.

Oh I forgot to mention as well, their customer service is top notch as well. It’s been a pleasure talking to Danny and Eun (sorry butchering his name)

user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough good things about Denny and his team at Fix Auto San Francisco/Sunny Auto Body. After I accidentally drove my white Audi Q5 into a post I was stressed and overwhelmed, but Denny was calm communicative and kind from the very first call. He worked with my budget and handled everything with my State Farm insurance which took a huge weight off my shoulders. The car came back looking beautiful and properly restored.

About a month later I had terrible luck and hit road debris. Without hesitation I called Denny again and once more he took care of everything with professionalism and clear communication. It is rare to find an auto body shop that is both highly skilled and genuinely caring.

If you want honest work clear updates and a team that truly has your back I would not go anywhere else.

user_reviews.Name: Cristina M
user_reviews.Description:
I can't believe I haven't left a review for Wayne here yet. He is world class, a master of his craft - he is truly passionate about car restoration. It shows in his absolute attention to detail, deep knowledge of care techniques and tools for cars, and radiant attitude. I was fortunate to come across Fog City Detail in 2022 and haven't gone anywhere else since. I drive a 1999 Suzuki Vitara, a car I have had since I was 15 years old, which I drove to Alaska and back, and up and down and across the US, and to every trailhead and campsite in California. My beloved car wouldn't still be on the road today without Wayne. He transforms my car every time I bring it in, making it look and feel better than new with his magic (read: extremely dedicated hard work).

Most recently, I spent a week in Big Sur over new year's during the downpours, hiking every day and my suzuki got flooded with rain water and mud, which then stagnate for a week until I got home. The first thing I did was call Wayne for help, and he worked on my Suzuki from 9:30 AM to 7 pm to save it. I teared up with joy when picking it up, I'm beyond grateful for Wayne's dedication.

Thank you Wayne, you are a gift to the world and to us car lovers. Please keep practicing your craft for a long long time. And if you are reading this and looking for someone to care for your car - count your blessings for having found Fog City and make an appointment now.

user_reviews.Name: Kelly Hagen
user_reviews.Description:
Wayne went above and beyond doing an INCREDIBLE job removing the mold situation from my Honda CRV, and making my whole car feel spic and span!!! Wow.

For almost two years i had to let my car sit while I was away, and i came back to mold/smell. It was BAD. Wayne successfully eradicated the mold and the smell - and he was so thoughtful in addressing the situation. Locating the source of the mold and making recommendations on things i can do to prevent it from coming back. He not only shampooed/vaccumed/etc etc, but also did an O2 treatment for the smell.

His shop is impeccably clean and well-organized. You can tell he takes pride in it.

I should mention that this is a camping car that I've taken cross country about 10 times, taken to Burning Man 9 times, taken to countless campgrounds and through every landscape imaginable. I have never in 20 years gotten my car detailed and have to sheepishly admit that in those two decades I've only done the occasional vaccum inside, eek. So there was a LOT of build up dirt, grime, playa dust, etc. He took care of it ALL!!!!! It feels amazing in there. Most importantly, the mold smell is GONE!!!

I'd also like to add that Wayne was incredibly communicative, and just an all around friendly and kind person. It's so nice to support a small business, especially one where you're treated like a real human and met with a smile. The sort of old school situation where next time I overhear someone looking to get their car detailed I'll enthusiastically offer "hey i know a guy!!"

I'm extremely grateful that I found Fog City Detail!!

user_reviews.Name: Ed Merrill
user_reviews.Description:
California Detailing is  simply outstanding. I brought my two day old Tesla Y to them.and they applied a ceramic coating, which makes the car so much easier to not only keep clean, but also much easier to wash as the dust, dirt and debris just slide off the car, making washing it by hand so much faster. I actually don’t use soap, just water and then dry it with a chamois.

I can now hand wash my car faster than driving to the car wash, let alone waiting for the car to come out of the car wash. And, by the way, in my opinion the car wash is actually is quite bad for the paint as it strips off the car’s protective layers.

The Tesla Y is a terrific car, especially for their FSD Supervised (Full Self Driving), however, Tesla’s paint job is noticeably inferior; having less layers of paint. So adding a ceramic coating is even more important.

I couldn’t help admire a few outstanding cars that were there; a gorgeous Austin Martin, a beautiful Porsche 911, etc., yet they treated me, with my $52,000 Tesla like a king. Needless to say, California Detailing is absolutely phenomenal in every way.

They did a much more thorough job applying the ceramic coating than the place I brought my Toyota RAV 4, which cost the same.

user_reviews.Name: Vivek Sridharan
user_reviews.Description: Paul lives, eats, breathes and sleeps detailing. He literally has a tattoo about detailing. He gives you pictures and updates and his work is thorough. We had a boba tea disaster in our Rivian thanks to the kids dropping 20 oz of milk and boba balls in between the seats and the floor. After a couple days it smelled nasty. He got in there, pulled out the carpet and the bolted on seats, got under the upholstery into the foam, and painstakingly alternated enzyme and ozone treatment. Car came back clean and smelling great, you would have never known about the carnage. And he fixed a couple of scratches for free just because he was mad about how terrible the last person who fixed it did. It took 2.5 days because the treatments had to cycle, but he came in on a Sunday to finish it just so we could get the car back. I respect that he also employs a lot of folks in his shop and patiently teaches them the trade. I will never go to a greedy corporate shop again.

user_reviews.Name: Jake Heller
user_reviews.Description:
Our cars were invaded by rodents. In our GMC Yukon XL, they chewed up the seatbelts until it was unsafe to drive it. In our Tesla, they had already caused $5k in damages to the suspension, and had set off another alert chewing through some wires. Then... something died in the Tesla, and it smelled like hell. Paul and his team took on both vehicles.

Paul and his team found exactly where the rodents were hiding (some were nesting in the car...). They found exactly where one had died, in a difficult-to-reach location in the Tesla that required removing a bunch of paneling. They combed over every inch of the cars for damage and repaired it all. They even patched things up and fixed things in a way that will hopefully prevent the rodents from ever getting in. The cars came back looking and smelling like nothing had happened to them.

To do this, they worked weekends, early mornings, etc., to get our cars back to us as fast as possible. Paul was incredibly communicative, sending over dozens of pictures as they did the work, asking questions at the right times, etc. I felt like I got great service on two vehicles that ended up being difficult jobs. I hopefully never have this problem ever again in my life... but if I do, or anything like it, I know where to go.

user_reviews.Name: Enzo Wiener
user_reviews.Description:
Paul is the real deal - don't look anywhere else.

I came to Paul with what I can only describe as a disaster of a car. Water damage throughout the interior, cracked tail lights, and a whole host of issues that had built up over time. Most detailers would have cleaned around the problems and called it a day - not Paul. He actually took the time to diagnose and fix the root cause of the water damage so I wouldn't be dealing with the same headache six months down the road. That kind of thoroughness and genuine care is incredibly rare, and it immediately told me I was dealing with someone who takes real pride in their craft.

The results spoke for themselves. Every surface, every corner, every crevice was immaculate - the car looked almost as good as the day I bought it. He tackled the cracked tail lights, addressed the water damage inside and out, and left absolutely nothing unfinished. You could tell he wasn't just going through the motions - he was making sure every single detail was right before he considered the job done.
And then, because apparently Paul just operates at a completely different level than everyone else, he offered to drop the car off at my place rather than having me come pick it up. He wanted to make sure the entire experience was seamless from start to finish.

If you want someone who treats your car like it's their own, goes beyond what's expected, and genuinely cares about leaving you happy - Paul is your guy. I won't be taking my car anywhere else.

user_reviews.Name: Ben Reyes
user_reviews.Description:
Lim at DetailedByPrecision is absolutely the guy you need to get your car detailed and protected.

I had a great experience with DetailedByPrecision! After the car dealer did a horrible job washing my car a brand new Black 2018 Honda Fit it was in need of some paint correction to fix the scratches.

DetailedByPrecision did a fantastic correction paint job, as well as apply CQuartz Protection which added a beautiful ceramic coating to the car. I also asked him to apply the CQuartz leather protection to the seats inside the car.

He did a completely thorough job, spending more time on the car to make sure it was perfect, and provided some of the best customer service I've received in a long time. A free maintenance wash was provided after the initial coating. He was super thorough in what needed to be done, how long it would take, and kept in in the loop if anything came up like additional scratches that needed to be taken care of.

If you're looking for a great San Francisco auto detailing company, you won't go wrong with Detailedbyprecision.

user_reviews.Name: Susan Ledford
user_reviews.Description:
You're going to think that this review is too good to be real. I know because I experienced it, and even I have trouble believing it.

First, Lenny was the only person I talked with about headlight restoration who advised me that replacing the headlights would give me a better result for perhaps less cost than restoring them. And he told me which headlights to buy and where to buy them relatively cheaply. So, I ordered headlights from EBay.

Second, when I told Lenny that I had received the headlights, he gave me a next-day appointment. I dropped off the car and picked it up several hours later. The new, shiny headlights fitted perfectly. Lenny took the time to explain what he did and how he did it and he demonstrated the headlights, turn signals, and such--to reassure me that all was working as it should.

For any task related to detailing, I will always to go Lenny.

user_reviews.Name: Bella S
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot recommend Golden Bay Detailing enough! I recently discovered mold on the back seats of my used car after it sat outside through the rainy season. I’ll admit, I initially thought the $300 quote for deep cleaning was a bit high, but after seeing the results, it was worth every penny.
I opted to add the $100 ozone treatment as well, and I have zero regrets. The team (two people) spent nearly 4 hours being incredibly thorough—It’s probably cleaner than when I first bought it used!
What really set them apart was the customer service. They offered to replace my air filter for free if I paid for the part. They even picked it up from O’Reilly on their way! My car requires a T20 driver and a 5.5mm socket for the filter—tools I don't own—so they saved me a huge DIY 'pain in the butt.'
Total transparency on pricing, no hidden fees, and I paid exactly what was quoted ($400 + the part). If you need a deep clean, don’t hesitate to call them. I’ll definitely be a returning customer!
